Required Technical Skills 
 7+ years of experience in automotive embedded software development, with strong exposure to motor control systems.
 Expert-level programming skills in Embedded C/C++ and strong understanding of real-time embedded systems and RTOS concepts.
 Hands-on expertise in motor control algorithms for PMSM, BLDC, or induction motors .
 Strong proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink for control algorithm development and model-based design.
 Experience with motor control peripherals, microcontrollers, and communication protocols, including CAN, LIN, and UDS diagnostics .
 Strong debugging and optimization skills using JTAG, TRACE32, or equivalent tools .
 Knowledge of ISO 26262 Functional Safety and ASPICE processes.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical leadership skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with AUTOSAR BSW development for motor control ECUs.
 Hands-on experience with MIL/SIL/PIL/HIL testing and validation.
 Knowledge of power electronics and inverter control software integration.
 Experience in automotive applications such as electric vehicles, electric power steering, or ADAS-related systems .
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Computer Science Engineering.

About The Role
 We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design, build and maintain test automation for embedded products. You will write Python frameworks and C test code that run against real hardware, simulators and production firmware. You will work closely with firmware, hardware and system teams to catch defects early and make every release faster and safer.
This is a senior, hands-on role. You will own the automation architecture, lead technical decisions and mentor other engineers, and you should be comfortable debugging at the boundary between software and hardware.
 Responsibilities
 Own the architecture and long-term roadmap of the test automation framework and infrastructure for embedded products.
 Design, develop and maintain automated test frameworks in Python, setting coding standards and best practices for the team.
 Write and maintain test code, test hooks and tools in C for firmware running on microcontrollers and DSPs.
 Lead the design of hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system-level test setups, including control of lab equipment (power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscopes, DAQs).
 Automate testing over communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Modbus and Ethernet.
 Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI, Jenkins) and keep them fast and reliable.
 Define test strategy, test plans and coverage together with firmware, hardware and system engineers.
 Lead root-cause investigations of complex failures across firmware, hardware and system level.
 Mentor and guide junior and mid-level engineers, and lead code and design reviews.
 Evaluate new tools and technologies and drive improvements in test efficiency, stability and coverage.
 Requirements:
 Requirements
 B.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field.
 At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing in Python, including designing test frameworks or automation tools from scratch (e.g. pytest).
 At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing in C.
 Proven experience leading test automation for software that runs on hardware, from architecture to deployment.
 Strong background in software design, object-oriented design and clean, maintainable code.
 Deep understanding of software testing methods: unit, integration, system and regression testing.
 Experience with Git and CI/CD tools, including setting up and maintaining pipelines.
 Comfortable working in Linux environments and with scripting.
 Ability to read schematics and datasheets and use lab equipment for debugging.
 Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work in a team.
 Good English, written and spoken.
 Advantages
 Experience with embedded systems, preferably from power electronics, automotive, robotics or similar industries.
 Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, simulators or test benches (e.g. dSPACE, NI, Typhoon HIL, Speedgoat).
 Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare-metal firmware.
 Knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN, Modbus, SPI, I2C, UART and Ethernet.
 Background in power electronics: inverters, converters, motor drives or battery systems.
 Experience with automotive or safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, ASPICE) or functional safety testing.
 Experience automating lab instruments with SCPI, VISA or PyVISA.
 Experience with C++, Docker or cloud-based test infrastructure.
 What we offer
 Work on products used at large scale in the field.
 A hands-on role with access to real hardware and well-equipped labs.
 Collaboration with experienced firmware, hardware and system engineers.
 Room to shape the automation strategy and tools.

**Ihre Aufgaben** 
* Requirementmanagement für elektrische Antriebs- und Energieerzeugungssysteme
* Systemauslegung und Spezifikation von Transformatoren, Schaltanlagen, Frequenzumrichtern und Motoren typischerweise im MW-Bereich
* Technische Projektleitung für den elektrischen Lieferumfang
* Erstellen von Berechnungen, Modellen und Simulationen für Antriebssysteme im Industrie- und Marinebereich
* Unterstützung in der Vertriebsphase und beim Kunden vor Ort
 **Ihr Profil** 
* Abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung
* Erste Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet von elektrischen Leistungs- und/oder Steuerungssystemen
* Erfahrung im Bereich Auslegung, Abstimmung und Simulation von elektrischen Leistungssystemen
* Erste Erfahrung mit Simulationstools z.B. PowerFactory, Mathlab Simulink
* Kenntnisse zu Regelung/Steuerung von Antriebssystemen
* Kenntnisse über allgemeine und branchenspezifische Normen und Richtlinien
* Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
* Weltweite Reisebereitschaft (Anteil ca. 5%)
* Ausgeprägte ziel- und prozessorientierte Vorgehensweise
* Blick für innovative Lösungsansätze
 **Was wir bieten** 
**Arbeitsvertrag:** Freuen Sie sich auf einen sicheren, unbefristeten Arbeitsplatz mit einer 35-Stunden-Woche und 30 Tagen Urlaub pro Jahr. Bei uns profitieren Sie von einer fairen und wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung nach IG-Metall-Tarif inklusive Sonderzahlungen.
**Gesundheit:** Ob mit dem Jobrad zur Arbeit oder beim Training mit Wellpass/ EGYM – wir unterstützen Ihre Fitness und Ihr Wohlbefinden. In unserer Betriebskantine erwartet Sie zudem eine ausgewogene Ernährung im Arbeitsalltag.
**Mobilität:** Laden Sie Ihr Elektroauto bequem bei uns vor Ort oder nutzen Sie ein Jobticket – wir bezuschussen Ihre umweltfreundliche Mobilität deutschlandweit.
**Betriebliche Altersvorsorge:** Planen Sie heute schon für morgen - wir unterstützen Ihre Zukunft mit einem attraktiven Arbeitgeberzuschuss.
**Weiterentwicklung:** Ihre Entwicklung liegt uns am Herzen. Wir fördern Sie mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung. Gestalten Sie die Zukunft aktiv mit! Wir suchen Mitarbeitende, die Spaß daran haben, Veränderungen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit RENK unser kontinuierliches Wachstum zu gestalten.
Für Ihre Bewerbung genügt uns zunächst Ihr Lebenslauf. Weitere Unterlagen fordern wir bei Bedarf im Verlauf des Auswahlprozesses nach. Bitte führen Sie relevante Zertifikate oder Zusatzqualifikationen direkt im Lebenslauf auf, damit wir uns ein umfassendes Bild machen können.

 What We Offer
 At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
 Group Summary
 Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Powertrain, and we do it by creating world-class powertrain systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex powertrain systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Powertrain.
 Job Responsibilities
 Job title:
 Engineer Software Testing
 Job Introduction
 We are seeking a highly skilled Software Test Engineer who has good knowledge on Powertrain, eDrive, Inverter with expertise in python programming, who could independently implement scripts based on requirements, and development / optimization of the tool for efficient working. The ideal candidate should have a good expertise of python, groovy, bash programming, electrical drives, dSpace & Vector tool chain.
 Major Responsibilities
 Develop, execute, and maintain software validation test cases for automotive ECU applications using HiL platforms.
 Design and implement automated test scripts and test frameworks using tools such as ECU-TEST and vTESTstudio.
 Perform system integration, functional, regression, and verification testing on HiL benches.
 Analyze software requirements and derive test cases ensuring complete requirement traceability.
 Work closely with software, system, and calibration engineers throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
 Develop and maintain test specifications, test reports, and test automation artifacts.
 Support issue investigation, root cause analysis, and defect management activities.
 Utilize Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools for requirements management, test management, defect tracking, and traceability.
 Contribute to continuous improvement of test processes, test automation, and validation methodologies.
 Knowledge And Education
 Bachelor's or master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Science engineering or a related field
 Work Experience
 3-8 years of experience in Software HIL test – Powertrain, eDrive, Inverter
 Skills And Competencies
 Strong understanding of Automotive Software Testing Processes and industry standards.
 Hands-on experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools such as: PTC Codebeamer, IBM Jazz.
 Test Automation tools - ECU-TEST, vTESTstudio
 Hands-on experience with Vector Tool Suite - CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape
 Strong experience working with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) systems: dSPACE SCALEXIO, 
 Vector VT System
 Good understanding of automotive communication protocols - CAN CANFD, UDS, XCP
 Strong programming/scripting skills in Python, Matlab M script and CAPL script.
 Experience in Powertrain Systems is highly desirable.
 Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
 Maintains safe work practices, complies with Magna H&S requirements, and participates in training and hazard reporting.
 Awareness, Unity, Empowerment
 At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
 AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure
 As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.
 Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making.
 If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.
 Worker Type
 Regular / Permanent
 Group
 Magna Powertrain

Key Responsibilities
 Develop vehicle models to be used for algorithm design and verification purposes
 Qualify and verify model accuracy by means of testing and analysis
 Develop Verification and Validation (V&V) tools for our rockets’ GNC systems
 Integrate numerical algorithms to embedded flight software
 Work closely with other teams to enable the successful integration of critical interfaces
 Take part in peer-review processes for GNC development
 Basic Qualification
 Master’s degree in Control Systems, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
 Experience in dynamic system modelling, control engineering, and system identification
 Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and Python
 Experience with C++ and embedded software development
 Knowledge of Git/SVN and CI/CD workflows
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Independent, structured, and collaborative working style
 Fluent in English; German is a plus
 Benefits
 €50 monthly Spendit Card – because it’s the little extras that make a difference
 Christmas bonus on top
 Job bike leasing for a sporty and sustainable commute
 €60 gift for special occasions (birthday, wedding, birth of a child)
 Regular team events – from Christmas parties to adventure offsites
 30 days of vacation to fully recharge
 Flexible working hours (flextime) to match your personal rhythm
 1 day of remote work per week
 Free coffee, tea & water – fuel for big ideas
 Open, respectful feedback culture at eye level
 Personal development opportunities through trainings, coaching & language courses
 Buddy program with structured onboarding, including a welcome package
 A diverse and inspiring startup environment, where talented people from over 16 nations collaborate to build something extraordinary
 Hands-on involvement across end-to-end development processes in a fast-growing New Space startup
 Location
Our location in Neuenstadt in the region of Heilbronn offers an ideal combination of rural charm and urban quality of life. Located in the heart of Baden-Württemberg, the region is characterized by its excellent traffic connections and diverse opportunities for leisure activities. Discover the advantages of this dynamic and liveable environment and benefit from a good work-life balance.
2023, Baden-Württemberg registered by far the most patents in Germany. A total of 16,000 people work in LR BW member companies and generate an annual turnover of around 5 billion euros - and the trend is rising. The strength of Baden-Württemberg's aerospace industry lies in the integrated value chain from the screw to the research satellite.
Equal Employment Opportunity
HyImpulse is committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age or disability.
 About Us
 HyImpulse is developing launch vehicles based on innovative hybrid propulsion technology and is constantly pushing boundaries beyond the limits within multiple disciplines to provide competitive low-cost and sustainable access to space. We are looking for exceptional talents who are passionate about rockets, ready to work in a fast-paced environment and take on challenging projects.

Job Tittle : AGM – BESS & C&I Engineering
 Department: Engineering / R&D
 Experience: 15–20+ Years
 Location: Bangalore
 Reporting To: VP – Engineering / COO
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Job Summary
 We are looking for an experienced engineering leader to head BESS (Battery Energy Storage Systems) and C&I (Commercial & Industrial) product engineering and development.
 The candidate will be responsible for technology development, product architecture, system integration, engineering design, product certification, supplier qualification, and manufacturing industrialization for Utility-Scale BESS and C&I Energy Storage solutions.
 Key Responsibilities
 Lead engineering and product development for Utility-Scale BESS and C&I Energy Storage systems.
 Develop product architecture, technology roadmaps, and standardized product platforms.
 Lead electrical, mechanical, thermal, structural, and control system engineering.
 Manage integration of Battery Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), PCS, HVAC, and Fire Suppression Systems.
 Review and approve engineering drawings, SLDs, GA drawings, BOMs, and technical specifications.
 Drive supplier technical evaluation, qualification, and component localization.
 Lead prototype development, DVT, PVT, FAT, and SAT activities.
 Ensure product certification and compliance with UL 9540, UL 9540A, IEC 62619, IEC 61439, NFPA 855, and applicable Indian standards.
 Drive New Product Introduction (NPI), Design for Manufacturing (DFM), and Design for Assembly (DFA).
 Lead Value Engineering (VAVE), cost optimization, product reliability, and quality improvement.
 Manage and develop multidisciplinary engineering teams.
 Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, procurement, supply chain, and project execution teams.
 Educational Qualification
 B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electrical & Electronics, or Power Electronics Engineering.
 M.E./M.Tech preferred.
 Experience & Technical Skills
 15–20+ years of experience in BESS, Energy Storage, Power Electronics, Solar Inverters, or EV Infrastructure.
 Strong knowledge of BESS architecture, battery systems, PCS, BMS, EMS, HVAC, and fire safety systems.
 Experience in electrical and mechanical product design and system integration.
 Knowledge of product certification, international standards, and grid compliance.
 Experience in product development, NPI, supplier qualification, and manufacturing industrialization.
 Knowledge of CAD, SLD, GA drawings, BOM, PLM, FMEA, DFM, DFA, and VAVE.
 Proven experience in leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
 Preferred Industry Background
 Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
 Lithium-Ion Battery Manufacturing.
 Energy Storage System Manufacturing.
 Solar Inverter and Power Electronics.
 Renewable Energy and EV Infrastructure.
 Electrical Switchgear and Power Distribution.

 Über die Rolle:
 Als Hardware Engineer BMS-Elektronik entwickeln Sie Batteriemanagementsysteme für Niedervolt- (LV) bis Hochvolt-Batteriesysteme (HV) bis 800 V. Sie begleiten Ihre Entwicklungen von der ersten Idee über Prototypen bis zur Serienreife und arbeiten eng mit System-, Software-, Mechanical-, Test- und Functional-Safety-Teams zusammen.
 Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung von:
 Batteriemanagementsystemen (BMS) im LV- und HV-Bereich
 Hochvolt-Batteriesystemen (bis 800 V)
 HV/LV- und LV/LV-DC/DC-Wandlern
 Hardwareentwicklung & Layout:
 Entwicklung analoger und digitaler Hardware für BMS und Batterieelektronik

 Erstellung von Schaltplänen und PCB-Layout
 Durchführung technischer Design Reviews
 Erstellung von Isolationen für Hochvolt-Systeme
 Analyse und Optimierung von EMV-, Temperatur- und Wirkungsgradverhalten
 Auslegung:
 Auslegung und Dimensionierung von BMS-Schaltungen für unterschiedliche Spannungslagen
 Auslegung von HV/LV- und LV/LV-DC/DC-Wandlern hinsichtlich Wirkungsgrad, Thermik und Zuverlässigkeit
 Entwicklung von Architekturen für komplette Batteriesysteme inkl. Batteriemanagement
 Testing & Validierung:
 Aufbau und Inbetriebnahme von Prototypen
 Durchführung von Laborversuchen und Messungen
 Funktions- und Hochvoltprüfungen an BMS und Batteriesystemen
 Serienentwicklung:
 Unterstützung bei Musterbau, Industrialisierung und Serienüberleitung
 Technische Abstimmung mit Lieferanten und Fertigung
 Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen
  Zusammenarbeit:
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Teamleitung, System Engineering, Konstruktion, Software, Functional Safety, Test, Einkauf und Projektmanagement
 Sie qualifizieren sich durch: 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung (oder gleichwertige Ausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung)
 1–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung
 Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Elektronik im Umfeld von Batteriesystemen und Batteriemanagementsystemen (BMS)
 Gute Kenntnisse in analoger und digitaler Hardwareentwicklung sowie in der Schaltplan- und Layouterstellung mit Altium Designer
 Grundkenntnisse im Umgang mit Batterietechnologien (z. B. Li-Ion) und Hochvolt-Systemen
 Erfahrung mit gängigen Labor- und Messwerkzeugen
 Kenntnisse im EMV-gerechten Hardwaredesign sowie Interesse an Functional Safety
 Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit im Team
 Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau
 Nice to have
 Kenntnisse in der Leistungselektronik, z. B. Entwicklung von DC/DC-Wandlern
 Erfahrung mit Hochvoltsystemen bis 800 V
 Erfahrung in Automotive-Serienentwicklungen sowie mit gängigen Entwicklungsprozessen und Normen (z. B. ISO 26262, LV123, LV124, IEC 60664)
 Erfahrung mit den Simulationswerkzeugen LTspice, MATLAB und PLECS, Automotive SPICE sowie Requirements Management

items.jobDescription:
Technologien auf das nächste Level zu heben, sich Herausforderungen zu stellen und an den Innovationen von morgen zu arbeiten - dafür benötigen wir bei FERCHAU Expert:innen wie dich: als ambitionierte:r Mitarbeitende:r für einen unserer Kunden. Wir realisieren spannende Projekte für namhafte Kunden in allen Technologiebereichen und für alle Branchen.
## Entwicklungsingenieur Steuergeräte (m/w/d)
**Dein Aufgabengebiet**
* Entwicklung und Validierung elektronischer Steuergeräte für anspruchsvolle Automotive Anwendungen
* Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Schaltplänen und Leiterplattenlayouts mit Altium Designer oder Eagle
* Entwicklung und Anpassung von Embedded Software in C und C++
* Planung und Durchführung von Hardware und Softwaretests unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Automotive Standards
* Integration neuer Funktionen in bestehende Steuergeräte und Systemarchitekturen
* Analyse technischer Fehler sowie Durchführung von Tests und Fehlerbehebungen im Laborumfeld
* Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Entwicklungsteams und externen Partnern
* Dokumentation der Entwicklungsergebnisse und Sicherstellung relevanter Qualitätsanforderungen nach ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
**Das erwartet dich bei uns**
* Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung durch Gleitzeitregelungen, Teilzeitmöglichkeiten und z. T. Vertrauensarbeitszeit
* Kollaboratives und digitales Arbeiten mit Tools von SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Atlassian
* Satte Rabatte mit Einkaufsvergünstigungen, z. B. bei Reisen, Elektronik oder Autos
* Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
* Prämienprogramm für Empfehlungen neuer Kolleg:innen
* Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Projekte bei innovativen Unternehmen
**Dein Profil**
* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
* Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Baugruppen und Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Automotive Umfeld
* Erfahrung mit Bussystemen wie CAN, LIN oder FlexRay von Vorteil
* Kenntnisse in Entwicklungs und Simulationstools wie MATLAB Simulink, Vector CANoe oder PSpice
* Verständnis für funktionale Sicherheit nach ISO 26262 sowie für EMV gerechtes Design
* Praktische Erfahrung im Prototyping sowie im Test elektronischer Systeme
* Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Projektteams
Lust auf die nächste Herausforderung? Dann sollten wir uns unbedingt kennenlernen! Am schnellsten geht es, wenn du dich direkt bewirbst - online unter der Kennziffer VA42-25176-W bei Frau Lisa Ragginger. Lass uns gemeinsam das nächste Level nehmen und Technologie nach vorn bringen!
Bewerbungsformular: [Zum Bewerbungsformular](https://recruiting.ferchau.com/de/de/entwicklungsingenieur-steuergeraete-528853)
Stellenausschreibung auf unserer Homepage: [Zur Anzeige auf der Karriereseite](https://touch.ferchau.com/de/de/job/528853/entwicklungsingenieur-steuergeraete)

Your tasks
 Imagine fleets of autonomous forklifts, each weighing several tons, lifting heavy loads into racks up to 14 meters high, safely and around the clock, right next to people. That's what we build at Jungheinrich Robotics, and AI-assisted engineering plays an important role in how we do it. In this role, you ensure that every one of these vehicles moves exactly as intended. 
 We are hiring at both Senior and Staff levels. Apply for the role that fits you best, and we'll find the right fit together! 
 You take ownership of the control software for our autonomous forklifts, from a unified hardware abstraction layer and actuator control based on ros_control/ros2_control to the interfaces with localization and navigation.
 You model and implement vehicle kinematics for different forklift types, including acceleration- and jerk-limited motion.
 You integrate motor controllers, drives, and actuators using fieldbus systems, particularly CANopen.
 You integrate and calibrate robot sensors, including encoders, IMUs, laser scanners, cameras, and lift height sensors.
 You improve the reliability of our robots in real-world environments through intelligent error handling, automated recovery mechanisms, and logging and analysis tools.
 You define and execute integration and system-level tests on real robots, test benches, and in simulation.
 You shape and drive the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the team, from coding and test generation to AI-supported log analysis.
 You develop technical concepts and architectures for robot control, analyze requirements and trade-offs, and align design decisions with system architects, safety experts, and navigation specialists.
 You drive cross-team initiatives and mentor colleagues, depending on your experience and expertise.
 Requirements
 You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, or bring equivalent practical experience.
 You bring at least 6 years of professional experience in robotics software development, including at least 3 years working with real mobile robots.
 You actively use AI-based tools, such as coding assistants, in your daily work and are eager to explore their potential further.
 You have proven experience developing technical concepts and architectures for robotic systems.
 You have a solid understanding of mobile robot kinematics, including acceleration-limited motion, and how localization and navigation interact with the hardware.
 You bring extensive experience with ROS1/ROS2 or comparable middleware, as well as ros_control/ros2_control or similar frameworks.
 You have experience integrating sensors, actuators, and fieldbus systems, ideally CANopen.
 You have strong programming skills in C++ and solid knowledge of Python. Experience with Rust is a plus.
 You bring in-depth expertise in at least one of the following areas: 
 Safety PLC applications, such as Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE, or SICK Flexi Soft. 
 Low-level, hardware-related software development, including CAN drivers, PROFINET, timing, and synchronization in sensor networks, ideally combined with microcontroller or embedded systems knowledge. 
 Autonomous software for real robots, such as localization, navigation, and motion planning, combined with an interest in developing deeper expertise in low-level control.
 You are passionate about developing software that enables heavy autonomous vehicles to move smoothly and safely, and want to help shape the future of large robotic fleets in real warehouse environments.
 You ideally have experience with jerk-limited motion, setting up complete mobile robot software stacks, or intralogistics applications involving automated forklifts, AGVs, or AMRs.
 You communicate fluently in English and have intermediate German language skills (B1 level or higher).
 You are willing to work on-site at our Munich location.
 What we have to offer
 Cutting-edge technology: As pioneers in robotics we can navigate and manipulate without rails and guides and offer solutions to processes that no one could automate ever before!
 Team: We are an international team with more than 25 nationalities. You’ll work in a team with exceptionally smart, humble, collaborative and hardworking individuals.
 Culture: Come as you are! Join a vibrant, inventive, and diverse team that values collaboration over hierarchy. To innovate you need to fail from time to time — we always learn and improve.
 Workplace: Our office is located near the S‑Bahn station “Hirschgarten”. We work in a loft-style office with great equipment, our own workshop and testing area.
 Full Board: You don’t feel like thinking about what you want to have for lunch tomorrow, not to mention preparing it? Luckily, our french cook treats us with a freshly cooked free lunch everyday! And as the cherry on top, there is a packed fridge with drinks, fresh fruits and of course coffee!
 Flexibility: Flexibility is a top priority for us. Our hybrid working model for positions where presence is dispensable helps to achieve a healthy work-life balance.
 Benefits : We offer attractive holiday, EGYM, health care, and compensation packages. Learn more about our current benefits here.
 Not sure if you meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know that great people don't always tick every box. If you're excited about the opportunity to help shape the future of robotics and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your experience may be a great fit for this role or another opportunity at Jungheinrich Robotics. 
 At Jungheinrich Robotics, where Magazino GmbH found its place, fostering inclusivity is very important to us. We are dedicated to create an inclusive environment for all candidates and provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, national origin, sexual orientation, culture, or education. If you need any reasonable adjustments to make the application process accessible for you, we’ll do our best to accommodate you. Feel free to approach us for that!

items.jobDescription:
Die Deutsche Bahn ist nicht nur einer der wichtigsten Mobilitätsdienstleister, sondern auch eines der größten Ingenieurbüros Deutschlands. Um neue Brücken, Tunnel, Bahnhöfe, Gleise und Signalanlagen zu realisieren und instand zu halten, arbeiten aktuell mehr als 10.000 Ingenieure bei uns – längst nicht genug. Als Ingenieur:in bei der Deutschen Bahn kannst du dabei etwas planen, managen oder überwachen, das bleibt: die Infrastruktur für kommende Generationen.
An über 5400 Bahnhöfen und Haltepunkten heißt die DB InfraGO AG, Personenbahnhöfe bundesweit täglich mehr als 20 Millionen Menschen willkommen. Als Deutschlands größte Gastgeberin geben wir alles, dass sich unsere Gäste bei uns sicher, informiert und wohl fühlen. Jährlich investieren wir mehr als 700 Millionen Euro in Bau- und Modernisierungsmaßnahmen sowie rund 140 Mio. Euro in die Instandhaltung der Bahnhofsanlagen. Wir entwickeln unsere Bahnhöfe zu wegweisenden Zentren der Mobilität, die neben den klassischen Verkehrsmitteln vielerorts auch Standorte von Leihfahrrädern und Carsharing-Angeboten beinhalten. An rund 800 Bahnhöfen bieten die Empfangsgebäude der DB InfraGO AG, Personenbahnhöfe den Reisenden gleichermaßen das Tor zur Stadt wie den Zugang zum Bahnsystem.
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als (Junior) Elektroingenieur:in als Bauüberwacher:in Elektrotechnik (50 Hz) (w/m/d) für die DB InfraGO AG an den Standorten Düsseldorf, Essen, Dortmund, Hagen und Münster.
Deine Aufgaben:
- Bei uns vertrittst du die DB InfraGO AG als Bauherr:in auf der Baustelle sowie die Interessen unserer Kund:innen, den Reisenden und Verkehrsunternehmen
- Dir obliegt die Steuerung der termingerechten Fertigstellung der Baumaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Bauüberwacher:innen weiterer Gewerke, der Projektleitung, sowie den externen Auftragnehmer:innen
- Als Spezialist:in für das faszinierende System Eisenbahn koordinierst du die Gewerke der Elektrotechnik / Höhenfördertechnik und stellst das gefahrenlose Ineinandergreifen verschiedener Auftragnehmer:innen sicher
- Die Gewährleistung des sicheren und reibungslosen Bahnbetriebs bei der Bauausführung und Einhaltung der Vorschriften gehört ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben
- Durch die Überwachung der Kosten, des Leistungsfortschritts, der Qualität und der Sicherheit hast du einen ganzheitlichen Blick auf deine Bauprojekte
- Deine Arbeitszeit teilst du flexibel zwischen der Baustelle und dem Büro auf, wobei der überwiegende Teil auf der Baustelle stattfinden wird
Dein Profil:
- Basis deines Werdegangs ist ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Fach- / Hochschulstudium der Elektrotechnik
- Erfahrungen in der Bauleitung bzw. der Realisierung von Infrastrukturprojekten sind ebenso von Vorteil wie erste Erfahrungen in den Bereichen HOAI, VOB, VOL sowie den gültigen gesetzlichen Regelungen
- Du besitzt die Funktionsausbildung zum Bauüberwacher:in Bahn oder bist bereit, diese zu erwerben
- Weiterhin arbeitest du selbstständig und strukturiert, überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Koordinationsfähigkeiten und gehst sicher mit MS-Office-Produkten um
- Du bist kommunikativ und entscheidungsfreudig und wir machen dich fit, damit du diese Stärken mit der nötigen Sicherheit auf unseren Baustellen einsetzen kannst
- Für dich zählen Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit direkt vor Ort auf den Baustellen, auch nachts oder am Wochenende
- Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst die gesundheitliche Tauglichkeit für die Tätigkeit mit, die im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses durch einen Betriebsarzt überprüft wird
Das ist uns wichtig:
Unser Anspruch ist es, allen Kandidat:innen bei gleicher Eignung die gleichen Chancen für den Einstieg bei uns zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv die Vielfalt und das Miteinander in unseren Teams. Wir schätzen jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.
Deine Vorteile
* Faszinierende Projekte und Aufgaben bei einer der vielfältigsten Arbeitgeberinnen des Landes fordern dein Können und warten auf deine Handschrift.
* Gezielte und individuelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten auf Fach-, Projekt- oder Führungsebene geben dir eine langfristige Perspektive.
* Du leistest Großes und bekommst auch Großes zurück: Ein tarifvertraglich geregeltes Gehaltspaket inkl. verschiedener Ausgleichmodelle für Überstunden, Weihnachtsgeld sowie vielfältige Nebenleistungen.
Chancengleichheit und selbstbestimmte Teilhabe Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter sowie eine respektvolle Zusammenarbeit sind innerhalb des DB Konzerns fest verankerte Grundsätze. Deshalb werden schwerbehinderte und gleichgestellte Bewerber:innen bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Die Kompetenz der Deutschen Bahn ist weltweit gefragt. Als führendes Ingenieur- und Beratungsunternehmen im Bahnsektor bietet die DB Engineering & Consulting GmbH seit 1966 dieses Wissen – von der Idee bis zum Betrieb. Über 6.000 Mitarbeitende aus 96 Nationen beraten unsere Kund:innen in Deutschland und rund um den Globus, entwickeln technisch anspruchsvolle und maßgeschneiderte Infrastruktur-, Mobilitäts- sowie Verkehrslösungen. Mit unseren Konzepten sichern wir den zukünftigen Erfolg von Wirtschaftsregionen und gestalten die Welt von morgen mit.
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als (Junior) Bauüberwacher:in im Qualifizierungsprogramm (w/m/d) mit Schwerpunkt Leit- und Sicherungstechnik für die DB Engineering & Consulting GmbH am Standort Rostock.
Du wirst im Rahmen eines Qualifizierungsprogramms über 2,5 Jahre als Bauüberwacher:in Bahn qualifiziert – dazu gehören neben der Praxis theoretische Seminare sowie schriftliche und mündliche Prüfungen.
Deine Aufgaben:
- Du bist Spezialist:in für die Umsetzung von Bauprojekten mit Schwerpunkt Leit- und Sicherungstechnik, stellst somit die Realisierung der Bauprojekte sicher und koordinierst zuverlässig den Baubetrieb sowie die Gewerke auf deiner Baustelle

Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply.
 We are seeking a skilled and driven Optical Engineer to design, analyze, and help realize the next generation of high-energy and high-average-power laser systems that underpin Focused Energy’s fusion program. In this role, you will be responsible for turning advanced optical concepts into robust, manufacturable, and operable experimental and production laser systems.
 Your work will directly enable the performance, stability, and scalability of our fusion laser infrastructure — ensuring that optical designs meet extreme power, precision, and reliability requirements while remaining practical to build, integrate, and operate.
 What you’ll do
 Optical System Design: Design, model, and optimize complex optical systems for high-energy and high-average-power laser applications, balancing performance, robustness, and manufacturability.
 Simulation & Analysis: Use advanced optical modeling tools (e.g., Zemax / OpticStudio) to perform ray tracing, tolerance analysis, stray light analysis, and wavefront propagation to predict and validate system behavior.
 Performance Specification: Define detailed optical specifications including component selection, materials, coatings, and tolerances to meet demanding power, fluence, and stability requirements.
 Integration & Commissioning: Partner closely with technicians, laser engineers, and mechanical and electrical teams during assembly, alignment, testing, and commissioning of optical systems, troubleshooting issues as they arise.
 System Optimization: Identify and resolve performance limitations related to aberrations, thermal effects, alignment sensitivity, and stray light to ensure stable, repeatable operation at high power.
 Documentation & Communication: Produce high-quality technical documentation, analyses, and design reviews to support internal development, knowledge sharing, and external collaboration.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work across disciplines to ensure optical designs integrate cleanly into larger laser, mechanical, electrical, vacuum, and control system architectures.
 Who you are
 A degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with professional experience designing and analyzing optical systems for laser or photonics applications.
 Deep hands-on experience with Zemax (OpticStudio) or comparable optical design and simulation tools, including tolerance and stray light analysis.
 Strong understanding of classical optics, Gaussian beam propagation, laser physics, and material behavior under high-intensity or high-fluence conditions.
 Comfortable moving between modeling and the lab — supporting alignment, testing, debugging, and iteration of real optical hardware.
 You bring rigor to your designs, anticipate failure modes, and care deeply about accuracy, documentation, and long-term reliability.
 You can work effectively with scientists, engineers, and technicians and communicate complex optical concepts clearly across disciplines.
 Preferred: Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar tools for analysis, modeling, or automation of design workflows.
 Preferred: Familiarity with cleanroom practices, vacuum-compatible optical design, large-aperture optics, or advanced components such as adaptive or deformable optics.

 About the role
 Software Engineers at Axle build the core infrastructure for connecting to distributed energy devices, orchestrating them, and allowing them to participate in electricity markets.

 The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

## About Huawei
Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. With integrated solutions across four key domains – telecom networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services – we are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world.
At Huawei, innovation focuses on customer needs. We invest heavily in basic research, concentrating on technological breakthroughs that drive the world forward. With approximately 208,000 employees, we operate in more than 170 countries and regions.
Huawei's end-to-end portfolio of products, solutions and services are both competitive and secure. Through open collaboration with ecosystem partners, we create lasting value for our customers, working to empower people, enrich home life, and inspire innovation in organizations of all shapes and sizes.
## Job Title:
**Junior Service Engineer for Smart PV Business (m/f/d) – Graduate Program**
## Job Location:
## Düsseldorf *or* Munich, Germany
## Main Responsibilities:
As a Junior Service Engineer in our Smart PV Business, you will join the **Digital Power Business Group** and contribute to delivering innovative digital and power electronics solutions that accelerate the transition toward a smarter, greener energy future. In this role you will handle following tasks:
- Support project engineering activities under the guidance of senior engineers, including hardware/software implementation, testing, installation, commissioning and customer training
- Provide remote and onsite technical support to customers, partners and subcontractors, troubleshooting issues and escalating complex or critical problems to senior engineers
- Support engineering partners and internal teams in investigating technical issues and implementing appropriate solutions
- Assist with pre-sales activities, including technical workshops, product presentations, demonstrations and preparation of technical information for bids and customer requirements
- Support quality and continuous improvement activities by documenting field issues, collecting customer feedback and identifying recurring technical problems
## Requirements:
- Recent graduate student with Bachelor/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering with focus on Power Engineering or related technical discipline
- First touch points with solar energy will be an advantage
- Good communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on defined tasks and effectively collaborate with customers, partners and internal teams
## Language requirements:
- Fluency in **English and German (C1-C2 level) is mandatory**
## Huawei's Fresh Graduate Program:
- We offer you an exciting professional career in one of the leading and fastest growing multinational telecommunication companies;
- Personal Development is ensured through training and workshop opportunities in the first 6 months;
- Firsthand experience in customer engagement and new technology innovation;
- Challenging and diverse assignments that enable you to continuously develop your personal and professional strengths;
- Mentor/Buddy Program: A mentor that will guide you through both business and intercultural development;
- After onboarding, internal networking activities with other fresh Graduates take place on a regular basis.
**Important:** To be considered for this role, applicants must be eligible to work and live in the job location.

We are committed to protecting your privacy by following the applicable data protection legislation. By applying to this position at Huawei, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the Huawei Recruitment Privacy Statement containing information on how we process your data. Please note that your data will be treated confidentially and securely.

Job Description:
 We are looking for an Algorithms and Simulation Development Engineer who thrives on high-stakes technical challenges. If you are passionate about unmanned systems and autonomy, this is your chance to directly influence a market-leading product. You will design the simulations and refine the algorithms that make the impossible possible, ensuring the highest level of precision and safety for our global customers.
 Algorithms and Simulation Development Engineer (d/f/m)
 As a core member of the DeckFinder team, you will report to the Chief Engineer. You will be the mastermind behind the brain of the DeckFinder system, your primary responsibility will be to develop, optimize and simulate the positioning algorithm and drive the simulation-driven development environment.
This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.
 Your location
 Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.
 Our Benefits for You
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities
 Algorithm & Software implementation 
 Create SW requirements 
 Implementation of new or improved algorithm into the software for new and existing product 
 Implementation according to the software design and coding principles 
 Writing effective and complete unit tests 
 Performing integration activities in target hardware 
 Software Validation and Verification 
 Responsible for the validation and verification of software from unit tests to flight test 
 Ensure all requirements are verified in accordance to high level needs of the program 
 Produce test reports to contribute to the overall release, qualification and certification of the product 
 Contribute to the overall V&V strategy 
 Release Management and Planning 
 Produce release planning that is compatible with the overall systems development planning in accordance to the needs of systems engineering and customer’s needs. 
 Ensuring releases are available to customers according to the planning 
 Follow defined release management processes 
 Software Definition & Design: 
 Lease with systems engineering and customers to capture high level software requirements of the DeckFinder system 
 Produce full and complete Design of the DeckFinder software products 
 Maintain the DeckFinder design to represent the latest developments 
 Contribute to the overall design strategy of DeckFinder 
 Define high level and low level software requirements 
 Overall Team Contribution 
 Contribute to the overall engineering planning 
 Contribute to the overall engineering process definition and refinement 
 Contribute to Technical Sales Support activities globally 
 Be an active member of the trials team, contributing to the safe and effective deployment of DeckFinder and test assets 
 Desired Skills And Qualifications
 Bachelors or Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Mathematics, Physics, Aerospace Engineering or a highly relevant engineering discipline. 
 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering and a strong mathematical mind 
 Proven experience in sensor fusion and Kalman filtering design and implementation. 
 Proven experience with MATLAB/Simulink, including knowledge of Embedded Coder and Matlab Compiler 
 Profound knowledge of C a must. Proven track record of developing according to MISRA-C a plus 
 Detailed knowledge of embedded software development (e.g. scheduler, U-Boot, firmware and I/O) a plus. 
 Knowledge Atlassian productivity suite (Conﬂuence, Jira, Bitbucket), Lauterbach debuggers 
 Proven track record developing software for a airborne systems, particularly in accordance to DO-178B/C a plus 
 Knowledge of the Lauterbach Embedded Trace and debugger a plus 
 Proven track record of developing unit and integration tests a must. Knowledge of CPPUnit framework a plus. 
 Proven track record of using version control a must. Knowledge of CI/CD tools e.g. Jenkins a plus 
 Willingness and ability to travel, 
 Fluent / negotiation level English is a must. German is a plus. 
 You have experience in Navigation Systems, Radar Systems (or Avionic Systems would be a plus)

Deine Aufgaben
 Stell dir Flotten autonomer Gabelstapler vor, die jeweils mehrere Tonnen wiegen und schwere Lasten in bis zu 14 Meter hohe Regale heben, sicher, rund um die Uhr und in unmittelbarer Nähe von Menschen. Genau das entwickeln wir bei Jungheinrich Robotics. Dabei spielt KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung eine wichtige Rolle. In dieser Position stellst du sicher, dass sich jedes dieser Fahrzeuge genau so bewegt, wie es soll. 
 Wir suchen Verstärkung sowohl auf Senior- als auch auf Staff-Level. Bewirb dich auf die Position, die am besten zu dir passt, und gemeinsam finden wir die richtige Rolle für dich. 
 Du verantwortest die Steuerungssoftware unserer autonomen Gabelstapler, von einer einheitlichen Hardware-Abstraktionsschicht und der Aktuatorsteuerung auf Basis von ros_control/ros2_control bis hin zu den Schnittstellen zur Lokalisierung und Navigation.
 Du modellierst und implementierst die Fahrzeugkinematik für unterschiedliche Gabelstaplertypen, einschließlich beschleunigungs- und ruckbegrenzter Bewegungsabläufe.
 Du integrierst Motorsteuerungen, Antriebe und Aktuatoren über Feldbussysteme, insbesondere CANopen.
 Du integrierst und kalibrierst Robotersensoren, darunter Encoder, IMUs, Laserscanner, Kameras und Hubhöhensensoren.
 Du verbesserst die Zuverlässigkeit unserer Roboter im realen Einsatz durch intelligente Fehlerbehandlung, automatische Wiederherstellungsmechanismen sowie Logging- und Analysetools.
 Du definierst und führst Integrations- und Systemtests an realen Robotern, Prüfständen und in Simulationen durch.
 Du gestaltest den Einsatz KI-gestützter Entwicklungsmethoden, von der Programmierung und Testgenerierung bis hin zur KI-gestützten Loganalyse, und treibst deren Einführung innerhalb des Teams voran.
 Du entwickelst technische Konzepte und Architekturen für unsere Robotersteuerung, analysierst Anforderungen und technische Abwägungen und stimmst Designentscheidungen auf Augenhöhe mit Systemarchitekt:innen sowie Expert:innen aus den Bereichen Safety und Navigation ab.
 Du übernimmst je nach Erfahrung und Expertise die Verantwortung für teamübergreifende Initiativen und unterstützt Kolleg:innen durch Mentoring.
 Dein Profil
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Informatik, Robotik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich oder bringst entsprechende praktische Erfahrung mit.
 Du bringst mindestens 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Robotik-Softwareentwicklung mit, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in der Arbeit mit realen mobilen Robotern.
 Du nutzt KI-basierte Tools, wie beispielsweise Coding-Assistenten, aktiv in deinem Arbeitsalltag und möchtest deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten weiter ausbauen.
 Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung technischer Konzepte und Architekturen für Robotiksysteme.
 Du bringst ein fundiertes Verständnis der Kinematik mobiler Roboter, einschließlich beschleunigungsbegrenzter Bewegungen, sowie des Zusammenspiels von Lokalisierung, Navigation und Hardware mit.
 Du verfügst über umfangreiche Erfahrung mit ROS1/ROS2 oder vergleichbarer Middleware sowie mit ros_control/ros2_control oder ähnlichen Frameworks.
 Du hast Erfahrung in der Integration von Sensoren, Aktuatoren und Feldbussystemen, idealerweise CANopen.
 Du verfügst über sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in C++ und solide Kenntnisse in Python. Erfahrung mit Rust ist ein Plus.
 Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche mit: 
 Sicherheitsgerichtete SPS-Anwendungen, beispielsweise Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE oder SICK Flexi Soft. 
 Hardware-nahe Softwareentwicklung, beispielsweise CAN-Treiber, PROFINET, Timing und Synchronisation in Sensornetzwerken, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen im Bereich Mikrocontroller und Embedded Systems. 
 Autonome Software für reale Roboter, beispielsweise Lokalisierung, Navigation und Bewegungsplanung, kombiniert mit dem Interesse, dein Wissen im Bereich Low-Level-Control weiter zu vertiefen.
 Du begeisterst dich dafür, mit deiner Software mehrere Tonnen schwere autonome Fahrzeuge sicher und präzise zu bewegen, und möchtest die Zukunft großer Roboterflotten in realen Lagerumgebungen mitgestalten.
 Du bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit ruckbegrenzten Bewegungsabläufen, dem Aufbau vollständiger Software-Stacks für mobile Roboter oder Intralogistik-Anwendungen mit automatisierten Gabelstaplern, AGVs oder AMRs mit.
 Du kommunizierst fließend auf Englisch und verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mittlerem Niveau (mindestens B1).
 Du bist bereit, vor Ort an unserem Standort in München zu arbeiten.
 Was wir bieten
 Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte!
 Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Individuen arbeiten.
 Kultur : Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativen und vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig.
 Arbeitsplatz: Unser Büro befindet sich in der Nähe der S‑Bahn-Station „Hirschgarten“. Wir arbeiten in einem Büro im Loft-Stil mit toller Ausstattung, eigener Werkstatt und Testbereich.
 Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was Du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee!
 Flexibilität: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei.
 Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, EGYM‑, Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahren Sie hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Mitarbeiterbenefits.
 Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 %? Kein Problem. Wir wissen, dass die besten Talente nicht immer jeden Punkt einer Stellenanzeige mitbringen. Wenn Du Dich für Robotik begeisterst und die Zukunft der Automatisierung mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht ist genau diese Position der richtige nächste Schritt für Dich oder eine andere spannende Gelegenheit bei Jungheinrich Robotics. 
 Für uns bei Jungheinrich Robotics ist die Förderung der Inklusion sehr wichtig. Wir sind daher bestrebt, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Kandidaten zu schaffen und bieten allen qualifizierten Bewerbern unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Kultur oder Bildung gleiche Chancen. Wenn Du gewisse Anpassungen benötigst, um den Rekruitingprozess für Dich zugänglich zu machen, werden wir unser Bestes tun, um Dir entgegenzukommen. Sprich uns gerne darauf an!

**Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied**
**Siemens Mobility** ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitenden sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten.
**Was tragen Sie bei?**
In Ihrer neuen Rolle werden Sie Teil unseres erfahrenen Projektierungsteams und unterstützen unseren Kunden, die DB InfraGO, bei der Modernisierung der Streckeninfrastruktur. #ZukunftBahntechnik

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.
We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.
We want you as a talented AIT Test Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that NYX can be integrated.
You will be successful in this role if you are able to help us:
 Prepare, execute and manage the internal or external dynamic testing (vibration test, shock tests,...) of several sub-systems (electronic, fittings, weldings...) and internally developed prototypes
 Prepare, execute and manage the internal or external thermal testing (cycling, TVAC...) of several sub-systems and internally developed prototypes
 Write documentation prior and post integration and test activities
 Prepare, execute and manage other testing activities in AIT domain (e.g.: parachute, EMC, mechanisms, Structural Test Model...)
 Support mechanical integration activities needed on Nyx Capsule
 Key Responsibilities
 You will manage the testing activities from definition of requirements to post-test reviews
 You will be responsible of writing, reviewing and executing procedures detailing the setups for integration and tests (in Epsilon3, ODOO, Team Center)
 You will be responsible for the execution of the tests performed in-house with internal equipment (vibration test bench, thermal vacuum chamber, shock test rig, ...)
 You will be responsible for the execution of the tests performed in external facilities
 You will be responsible of the procurement (or rental) of instrumentation and its installation on the items to test
 You will be expected to interact with other AIT engineers and technicians but also with external stakeholders
 You will be largely involved in the resolutions of anomalies happening during the integration and tests
 You will manage the reports to be done at the end of the operations/tests
 You will give your feedback and report on any blockage or problem during the testing and will work to propose improvements and fixes
 You will be asked to support the qualification plans of new processes within AIT (welding, fittings...)
 You will be supporting the Purchase of all the equipment (COTS or not) needed to run the testing activities (Tools, generic GSE)
 You will be working with AIT technicians and MGSE team to define needs of machined parts and/or tools (proposing design, follow up with MGSE team)
 Additional Requirements
 Versatile, in order to support several activities depending on the workload
 Being able to manage several topics at the same time (preparation of next tests and execution in parallel)
 Proficient in following safety standards and maintaining quality control during all assembly and test operations. 
 Qualifications And Experience
 Engineering degree (Master or PhD) in mechanical science, instrumentation/test or equivalent
 Experience in the AIT of aerospace vehicles
 Prior experience with Vibration Tables, Thermal Chambers or similar equipment is a plus
 Mechanical skills with electrical/digital and electromechanical knowledge would be appreciated
 Skills And Behaviors
 Leadership skills
 Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks
 Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done
 Ability to communicate at all levels of the business in English
 Organized and rigorous
 Hands-on approach
 Inventive and problem solver, team spirit
 Able to document all tasks in written form
 Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Mission, Teamwork, Integrity and Excellence

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.
 We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.
 We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.
 Read more about what we’re building here .
 About the role 
 Solutions Engineers at Axle build the integrations and technical infrastructure that enable our customers to connect distributed energy devices, orchestrate them, and participate in electricity markets.
 This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. You will work closely with our customers to understand their technical requirements, build integrations, solve complex technical challenges, and help shape our product based on real world feedback.
 We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions.
 At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.
   Solutions Engineering at Axle looks like 
 Forming a deep understanding of our domain, our platform, and our customers' technical challenges, so you have enough context to execute at speed.
 Building and maintaining integrations with customer systems, distributed energy devices, and third-party platforms.
 Working closely with customers to troubleshoot technical issues, support implementations, and design scalable solutions.
 Steering customers towards a more direct launch plan and a better user experience.
 Collaborating closely with our Product team to turn customer feedback into product improvements.
 Focus on outcomes rather than process, taking ownership of the quality and impact of the final product you deliver.
 Manage your own time and support others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, to deliver 80% of the value in 20% of the time
 What we’re looking for 
 3+ years of software engineering experience, ideally building integrations or customer-facing technical solutions.
 A track record of working directly with customers: scoping requirements, leading implementations, and owning the technical relationship.
 Tech stack 
 🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend
 🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.
🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly
 ☁️ We deploy on GCP
 What's in it for you 
 A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).
 We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.
 Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.
 Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.
 Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.
 The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.
   We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

About Us 
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 About the Role 
 The Material Flow Engineer designs, builds, and optimizes the end-to-end physical movement and presentation of hardware from receiving docks through warehousing, kitting, and lineside delivery, to support high-rate production schedules and rapid manufacturing scale. This role owns the physical-to-digital operating mechanisms that translate factory layouts and inventory data into executable material handling workflows, including Plan for Every Part (PFEP) management, facility layout engineering, and custom material handling hardware design.
 You will serve as the connective tissue between Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, driving inventory accuracy, eliminating lineside bottlenecks, and deploying low-CAPEX, high-impact floor solutions before scaling to automation. In addition to daily floor execution, you will partner closely with Design Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Facilities to support New Product Introduction (NPI) line readiness, factory expansions, and continuous lean process improvements.
 Key Responsibilities 
 End-to-End Material Flow Design: Analyze, design, and optimize the receiving, storage, movement, and lineside presentation of all production and non-production materials to eliminate technician search and walk time.
 Plan for Every Part (PFEP) & Data Ownership: Build, maintain, and own the PFEP database defining part dimensions, packaging specifications, containerization, storage media, replenishment triggers (Kanban/min-max), and delivery frequencies.
 Factory & Warehouse Layout Engineering: Create conceptual and detailed 2D/3D facility layouts (AutoCAD/CAD) for warehouse racking, supermarket zones, tugger routes, and lineside staging to support scalable production rates.
 Custom Hardware & Packaging Development: Design, procure, and deploy custom material handling equipment, including kitting carts, lineside racks, dunnage, and returnable packaging, to protect sensitive components and ensure seamless point-of-use presentation.
 Constraint & Bottleneck Mitigation: Conduct daily Gemba walks, time studies, and root-cause analyses to proactively identify material flow bottlenecks, implement poka-yoke (error-proofing) workflows, and resolve floor constraints before they impact build schedules.
 Cross-Functional & NPI Alignment: Represent material flow readiness in production, NPI, and operational review meetings. Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Operations Leadership to support new line launches, facility expansions, and engineering changes.
 Performance & Data-Driven Optimization: Extract and analyze production, inventory, and cycle-time data using SQL and ERP/WMS systems to right-size buffer stock, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and drive down material handling costs.
 Qualifications & Skills 
 Masters’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related technical/analytical discipline.
 2+ years of hands-on engineering experience in a fast-paced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, automotive, or high-volume production environment involving complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies.
 Strong hands-on knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Just-In-Time (JIT), Kanban, Plan for Every Part (PFEP), and Six Sigma principles applied on an active production floor.
 Proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or equivalent) for facility layout engineering and custom cart/rack design.
 Experience querying and analyzing operational and ERP/WMS data using SQL, Python, or advanced Excel to drive material flow and inventory decisions.
 Demonstrated experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) line launches, greenfield facility buildouts, and production ramps.
 Strong cross-functional communication skills with a proven ability to influence production teams, engineering peers, and leadership on the shop floor.
 Adaptable, hands-on problem solver willing to balance analytical modeling with immediate physical execution on the factory floor in a rapidly changing environment.
 Ability to work 100% onsite and travel up to 20% as needed to supplier sites or sister manufacturing facilities.
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

 About Us 
 Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The company is constantly innovating to provide efficient and technologically advanced solutions in aerospace, defense, and connected services. In the commercial aircraft sector, Airbus offers the most modern and fuel-efficient aircraft families. Airbus is also a European leader in defense and security and one of the world's largest space companies. As such, we are actively shaping the technological future to strengthen the security and sovereignty of Europe. 
 Role 
 As AI Foundations Engineer, you will help build and run the platform that every AI agent, within Airbus Engineering, depends on. You'll join a small, fast-moving team with startup energy, delivering the agentic roadmap for the whole of Engineering. You will work hands-on across model hosting, retrieval pipelines, security and monitoring, turning architecture decisions into systems that run reliably every day. This role suits an engineer early in their career who wants to grow fast on hard infrastructure problems and help shape the next generation of AI-powered vehicle development. 
 Location: Munich or Madrid or Toulouse or Paris or Hamburg 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Deploy and run AI models. Set up, test and maintain model hosting across managed APIs and self-hosted open-weights models (vLLM or equivalent). Help measure latency, throughput and GPU use, and make sure each workload runs on the right setup for its data classification. 
 Build retrieval pipelines. Develop and maintain the pipelines that make engineering documents usable by agents: ingestion, chunking, embeddings and vector databases. Test retrieval quality and improve it step by step with the wider team. 
 Implement security guardrails. Put the agreed security controls in place: access management, secrets handling, sandboxed execution, prompt-injection defences and masking of sensitive and export-controlled data. Work with IT security on reviews and fixes. 
 Set up monitoring and evaluation. Instrument agents and models with tracing, logging and dashboards for latency, errors, cost and quality. Support continuous evaluation runs and flag issues early. 
 Keep the team moving fast. Build and maintain the environments, CI/CD pipelines and shared services that let a new demonstrator go from idea to running in days. Try out new models and tools and report on what works. 
 Support handover to operations. Help prepare documentation, runbooks and readiness checks, so solutions matured up to TRL 9 transfer cleanly to the Digital teams for deployment and maintenance.
 Your Profile 
 Required qualifications 
 3–5 years of experience in software, cloud, DevOps or MLOps engineering, including hands-on work with LLM or ML systems. 
 Practical experience deploying or serving models, through APIs or self-hosted. 
 Working knowledge of retrieval systems, embeddings and vector databases. 
 Experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. 
 Good grasp of security basics: access control, secrets management, network segmentation. 
 Strong Python and scripting skills. 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience with GPU infrastructure or on-premise environments. 
 Familiarity with observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) and LLM tracing or evaluation tools. 
 Exposure to regulated industries or export-control constraints. 
 Cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) or Kubernetes certifications. 
 Experience in a startup or innovation team.
 What We Offer 
 The unique opportunity to shape the future of aircraft engineering at a world-leading aerospace company. 
 An inspiring work environment that combines the innovative power of a startup with the expertise of an established technology site. 
 A team of brilliant minds working together on a grand vision for Europe's technological sovereignty. 
 Excellent professional development opportunities within the Airbus group. 
 Interested? Apply now!

 In this role, you will be responsible for understanding test requirements, developing automated test sequences, and executing validation activities on HIL platforms.

 Analyze system and ECU test plans and derive automated test scenarios.

 Support verification and validation of automotive embedded systems and ECUs.

 🎯 Required Skills & Experience:

 Ability to quickly learn and adapt to proprietary/internal coding languages and frameworks.
 ⭐ Nice-to-Have Skills:
 Knowledge of CAN, LIN, Ethernet, or automotive communication protocols.
 🌍 Languages:
 English: Professional fluency required for collaboration with international teams.
 French: Professional fluency is desirable.
 📩 Apply Now
 If you are an experienced Automotive Embedded ECU HIL Test Automation Engineer, we'd love to hear from you.
 Are you interested?
 Please apply to the position or alternatively share your resume, number, email to james@aliumc.com

Your profile Machine Learning Engineer Turba Labs   · Heidelberg (Germany) or San Francisco Bay Area (USA) · On-site, hybrid or remote · Full-time · Candidates must live in Germany or the USA 
 A scheduling idea that works in a notebook is a rumor until it survives a client's cluster. Data centers now run mixed clusters of GPU generations, vendors and accelerators, and the software that schedules work on them was mostly built for uniform hardware. Turba Labs is building what replaces it, and it has to work on infrastructure we do not control. 
 Two products. The   Scheduler   runs live on our clients' infrastructure and decides which workload runs on which GPU, and when. The   Simulator   answers a related question before a data center spends a cent: given a planned build-out, what is the best way to use it? You make what we build reliable enough for a data center to depend on. 
 What you will own 
 Research to production. Take a validated idea into the Scheduler: design it, build it, test it, roll it out, monitor it, and own what happens after.
 The ML platform's architecture. The decisions others build on, including when a learned approach earns its operational cost over a simple heuristic.
 Training, evaluation and benchmarking pipelines. Every scheduling policy and performance model reproducible and comparable, so progress is measured, not argued.
 GPU-level reality. Profile and optimize workloads and models on heterogeneous hardware, and feed what you measure back into the Simulator.
 Safe failure. Guardrails, fallbacks and observability, so the system running on infrastructure we do not control degrades gracefully, never dramatically.
 The interfaces. Clear contracts and release plans with the infrastructure and product engineers around you.
 Who you are 
 You have shipped ML into production and carry the operational weight, not just the model.
 You are strong in Python and PyTorch and practice real software engineering: tests, review, CI, and design that survives the next person.
 You think in trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost and risk, and you can say why you chose what you chose.
 You are comfortable close to the hardware, or hungry to be.
 You write designs and tickets that others can execute without a follow-up call.
 We do not screen on years or titles. We screen on the hardest system you have shipped and how deeply you understood it. 
 A plus 
 GPU performance work: profiling, CUDA, inference engines such as vLLM or TensorRT, distributed training.
 Experience with cluster or workload schedulers, Linux systems work and Docker.
 Reinforcement learning, optimization or simulation in a production setting.
 Deploying software into customer-managed or on-premises environments.
 Why this 
 This is infrastructure software that changes how AI compute gets used. What you ship here runs on real hardware in real data centers, with real money on the line, alongside the researchers who design the methods. 
 Why us?

 Tasks
