 Your projects may include:
 Designing and developing AI applications, such as enterprise assistants, AI copilots, semantic search platforms and intelligent automation systems
 Building LLM-powered applications using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and modern AI frameworks
 Developing end-to-end AI products, integrating LLM APIs, enterprise data sources and backend services
 Designing scalable AI microservices and APIs to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms
 Implementing vector search, embeddings pipelines and knowledge retrieval systems
 Rapidly prototyping AI product features and proof-of-concepts and evolving them into production systems
 Collaborating closely with product managers, designers, AI engineers and enterprise customers to develop impactful AI solutions
 Deploying AI systems to cloud platforms and production environments using modern DevOps practices
 Ensuring reliable, scalable and observable AI services through CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and containerized deployments
 Benefits 
 Work in an open and collaborative environment within the global Reply network and build next-generation AI applications and intelligent digital products
 Collaboration with interdisciplinary teams including AI engineers, software developers and data scientists across industries such as Banking, Insurance, Automotive and Retail
 A very active social program including paid training, conferences, communities of practice, hackathons and Reply XChange
 Monetary Benefits include: Mobility package, Gym subsidy & WellPass, Insurance & Pension Scheme, Corporate Savings Plan, KiTa and Childcare Allowance
 Flexible work arrangement between home office, EU-wide workation options, on site office-work in our downtown Munich office with access to Stammstrecke, and client on site visits
 Requirements 
 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a comparable technical field
 Convincing communication and presentation skills in German and English in order to participate in workshops of both languages
 Strong programming skills in Python and modern backend frameworks
 Experience building applications using AI, machine learning or generative AI technologies
 Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector databases
 Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP
 Engaging directly with enterprise clients to understand their business challenges and identify high-impact opportunities for AI-driven solutions
 Nice to have 
 Experience running technical workshops or facilitating solution design sessions
 Experience developing APIs, microservices and scalable backend systems, including vector databases
 Experience with containerization and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes or similar)
 Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex or HuggingFace
 Experience deploying AI services in cloud environments
 Knowledge of AI observability, monitoring, and evaluation of LLM systems
 Example projects you may work on 
 Enterprise AI knowledge assistants
 AI copilots for internal business tools
 Semantic search platforms for enterprise data
 Document intelligence systems powered by LLMs
 AI agents and automation systems for enterprise workflows

items.jobTitle: Click Z - Graduate Content & Audience Strategist
items.jobDescription:
Do you follow every shift in digital marketing, media and commerce, and always have a view on which stories matter the most?
 Do you want to create content across channels that educates the next generation of marketers?
 Does the idea of shaping the content for one of digital marketing's longest-running publications excite you?
 If so, we'd love to hear from you! 
 About us
 Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.
 About ClickZ 
 ClickZ is Fospha's media partner and one of the world's longest-running digital marketing publications, trusted by CMOs and senior marketers since 1997. Its focus is how measurement shapes marketing decisions, and it covers the wider marketing that measurement informs. Readers come to ClickZ to understand:
 How marketing leaders build teams, explain results to finance and earn influence in the room
 Retail and commerce marketing, including retail media and marketplaces
 How AI, search and ad platform changes affect planning and results
 Where to invest across brand, creative, performance, affiliate and influencer marketing
 How brands measure performance, from attribution and incrementality to mix modelling
 The Role
 This is a permanent role at the heart of ClickZ. You'll run the day-to-day content engine: spotting the stories that matter to marketing leaders, turning them into sharp content across email, social and the website, and growing the audience that reads it.
 The work is varied. In a single week you might cover a session at a major commerce event, publish a piece on a platform change, prepare a leadership Q&A, and review a stack of contributor pitches. You'll also build ClickZ's network of event partners, contributors, PR contacts and industry leaders, and meet many of them in person at industry events.
 You'll work closely with ClickZ's lead, who sets the brand's strategy, and you'll have real ownership of your workstreams from the start. This is an office-based role in London.
 This role suits someone with a journalist's instinct for a story, a marketer's eye for an audience, and the energy to keep both going every week.
 What you'll work on
 Your time will be spread across three areas, with content creation at the core. All three serve one goal: growing the ClickZ brand and getting its content to more of the right people.
 Focus area 
 What it covers 
 Content creation 
 The core of the role: editorial content on market trends, event coverage, brand leadership interviews and Q&As, flagship newsletters, and social content 
 Audience growth and content analysis 
 Growing ClickZ's readership and subscribers, testing new formats, and using performance data to decide what to create next 
 Network and community 
 Building relationships with event partners, marketing and commerce leaders, PR teams and contributors, online and in person at industry events 
 Key Responsibilities
 Keep the content engine fed. Track the news and trends that matter to marketing and commerce leaders, and turn them into timely, well-argued content.
 Raise the bar on every channel. Bring a creative eye to email, social and web content, and build a distinct content plan for each channel.
 Shape the flagship newsletters. Draft and refine ClickZ's flagship newsletters, and develop more tailored formats for different parts of the audience.
 Bring leadership conversations to life. Prepare and support podcast and Q&A conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce, and, with training and support, grow into hosting them.
 Grow the audience. Work out which formats and topics readers respond to, and turn readers into subscribers. Design campaigns that bring back readers who've gone quiet.
 Let data inform the calls. Track what content delivers, use the numbers to decide what to do next, and share what's working.
 Be the first filter. Review PR pitches and contributor submissions, and pick out the strong and relevant ones.
 Build the network. Reach out to contributors, speakers and event partners, grow an always-on contributor community, and build lasting relationships with PR teams and industry leaders.
 Get out into the industry. Attend events, support event partnerships, and find new events worth ClickZ's time.
 Work agentically. Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting and multimedia content, while owning the quality of what goes out.
 What are we looking for?
 We hire for potential and taste. You should apply if you meet these six must-haves:
 Have around one year of experience creating content in the digital marketing, media or commerce world, whether in journalism, editorial, content or social roles (internships, placements and personal projects count), and a genuine passion for digital marketing and commerce, and for the leaders shaping them
 Have strong editorial judgement : you can tell good content from weak, and relevant from noise, and you know a big story when you see one (experience of writing, editing or curating, including student or personal publications)
 Bring a creative eye to content across email, social and web, with a feel for multimedia formats
 Are audience-minded : you think about who's reading, how to reach more of the right people and how to build a community around a brand. You're also comfortable with data: you use performance numbers to make content decisions and back up your conclusions (experience using analytics such as GA4)
 Are agentically minded : you love experimenting with new tools for multimedia content creation and adaptation, and know when to push them and when to take over
 Are a natural conversationalist : you get a guest talking, hold your own with senior leaders, and leave an event with new connections
 Also important: 
 Have high agency : you take ownership of your work, stretch beyond the brief and challenge the status quo when something could be better
 Enjoy a fast-paced, innovative startup environment, where you'll ship quickly, iterate often and juggle several projects at once
 Are happy to travel for industry events, within the UK and occasionally overseas
 Our Values and Principles
 You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:
 Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
 Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
 Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
 Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
 Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude
 What we can offer you
 Salary: £34k + discretionary 10% bonus
 Ownership of content for a media brand that has covered digital marketing for nearly 30 years
 Early ownership of your workstreams, and the chance to shape how modern marketers learn and make decisions
 A growing network across PR teams, contributors and industry leaders
 Hands-on podcast experience, with regular conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce
 A place at major industry events, with a front-row view of commerce, media and digital marketing
 Be part of a leading global venture builder, Blenheim Chalcot , and learn from the incredible talent in BC
 The right mix of challenges, learning and development opportunities
 A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%
 A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!
 Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps
 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)
 Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one
 Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more
 Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance
 Paid volunteering days each year
 Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community
 Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices
 Top tip: Share two or three pieces of content you're proud of, and tell us one story ClickZ should cover next, and why.

 Successful candidates can join us between May-October 2027.

 About the role 
 Championing user experience and brand is central to our work at CC, and Industrial Designers lead this thinking for our clients. You will work in diverse multifunctional project teams together with highly talented engineers, scientists and designers to generate innovative solutions and develop world- leading medical, consumer and wider products for our clients around the globe.

 Evaluate user needs and designs at user studies 
 Share your skills and experience with the wider design team whilst also receiving mentorship from experienced designers 
 What you’ll need 
 A successful designer at CC will: 
 Be a talented and creative Industrial Designer who is an enthusiastic team player 
 A top degree in Industrial Design, Product Design or a related design discipline 
 An excellent portfolio demonstrating your visual flair, meticulous attention to detail and ability to communicate innovative designs in a clear and attractive way.

 We cannot accept applications that do not include a portfolio.

Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft ([www.fraunhofer.de](https://www.fraunhofer.de/ "www.fraunhofer.de")) ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.
Die Abteilung „Fabrikation – Forschung und Entwicklung“ am Fraunhofer-Institut für Siliziumtechnologie ISIT bildet das Herzstück der technologischen Umsetzung von Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten in der Mikrosystemtechnik und Leistungselektronik. Sie ist unterteilt in vier Gruppen, die die Planung und Erstellung von Fertigungsanweisungen, die Ausführung der MES-gesteuerten Fertigung im Reinraum sowie die Wartung und den bedarfsgerechten Ausbau ihrer Halbleiterfertigungsanlagen vereinen.
Die Gruppe „Prozessentwicklung und Fertigung“ ist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Einzelfertigungsprozessen auf industriellen Halbleiteranlagen und die Herstellung mikromechanischer und leistungselektronischer Bauelemente auf Si-, Glas- und GaN-Substraten im Reinraum II des Fraunhofer ISIT. Dies schließt auch eine kontinuierliche Überwachung und Analyse der Prozessqualität und -ergebnisse ein. Für diese Gruppe suchen wir einen engagierten wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeiter / Prozessingenieur (all genders) im Bereich der Lithographie. 
**Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung**
- Sie betreuen gemeinsam mit weiteren Teammitgliedern moderne Produktions-anlagen im Photolithographiebereich unseres Reinraums.
- Sie entwickeln neue und optimieren vorhandene Lithographieprozesse an unseren Steppern, Mask-Aligner, Resist-Coater / Resist-Developer.
- Sie wirken gemeinsam mit unseren Integratoren in Entwicklungs- und Fertigungsprojekten bei der Implementierung neuartiger Verfahren und Prozesse mit.
- Zur Sicherstellung der Anlagen- und Prozessverfügbarkeit im Photolithographiebereich stimmen Sie sich mit dem Equipmentserviceteam ab und koordinieren die Verfügbarkeit von Verbrauchsmaterialien in Ihrem Bereich für eine optimale Arbeitsfähigkeit und reibungslose Abläufe.
- Gegebenenfalls stimmen Sie sich mit anderen Fertigungsbereichen im Reinraum ab, um so eine Abarbeitung zeitkritischer Prozessabfolgen sicherzustellen.
**Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein**
- Ein abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium in Physik, Materialwissenschaften, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Disziplin
- Fundierte Kenntnisse und Praxis in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche:
 - (Lithographische) Fertigungsverfahren der Halbleitertechnologie
 - Statistische Methoden zur Prozessbewertung
 - Entwicklung von komplexen MEMS und/oder leistungselektronischen Halbleiterbauelementen / Prozessen
- Gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift
- Ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative, Einsatzbereitschaft und die Fähigkeit, sich schnell in neue Problemstellungen einzuarbeiten und im Team Verantwortung zu übernehmen
- Für eine stetige Verbesserung des Teams bringen Sie gute Ideen mit, setzen diese nach Absprache mit dem Team und der Gruppenleitung um und bewerten ihre Wirksamkeit.
- Vor allem aber bringen Sie eine Begeisterung für technisch-wissenschaftliche Themen mit starkem Anwendungsbezug mit und bereichern damit unsere Abteilung.
**Was wir für Sie bereithalten**
- Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung zur Unterstützung der Vereinbarkeit von Privatleben und Beruf
- 31 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr
- Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement und betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL)
- Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket
- Kostenlose Mitarbeiterparkplätze
- Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Es erwartet Sie ein hochmotiviertes Team an Mitarbeitenden in einer innovativen und professionellen Fertigungsumgebung.
- Ein engagiertes Führungsteam und das Kollegium begleiten Sie, unterstützen Sie aktiv bei Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung und sorgen dafür, dass Sie sich schnell in Ihrem neuen Aufgabenbereich zurechtfinden.
- Sie können sich auf eine offene, kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre freuen.

 Zur langfristigen Verstärkung unseres Stadler + Schaaf Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Sie als
 Ingenieur / Techniker (m/w/d) Automatisierungstechnik für Hardwareplanung 
 Sie möchten anspruchsvolle Industrieprojekte mitgestalten und Ihr Know-how in der Elektroplanung gezielt einbringen? Freuen Sie sich auf abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben rund um die Planung und Auslegung elektrischer Anlagen, ein technisch anspruchsvolles Umfeld sowie spannende Projekte in der Energiebranche. Dabei erwarten Sie moderne Technologien, eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und eine langfristige Perspektive.
 Ihre Aufgaben umfassen: 
 Sie entwickeln Basic- und Detail-Engineering-Konzepte im Bereich EMSR-Technik für Projekte in den Branchen Pharma- und Biotechnologie sowie der produzierenden Industrie
 Die Projektierung von Schaltschränken und die Erstellung von Stromlaufplänen setzen Sie mit CAD-/CAE-Tools wie EPLAN P8, ProDOK oder Planeds um

 Die Ausarbeitung von Montagespezifikationen sowie die Erstellung und Pflege der EMSR-Dokumentation gehören zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich
 MSR-Komponenten wie Sensoren, Aktoren und Schaltschränke sowie Leit- und Steuerungssysteme (PLS/SPS) legen Sie aus und spezifizieren diese entsprechend den Projektanforderungen
 Als technischer Ansprechpartner unterstützen Sie die Projektabwicklung und stehen internen sowie externen Projektbeteiligten beratend zur Seite
 Das bringen Sie mit:

 Erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Hardwareplanung, EMSR-Technik oder der Umsetzung von Automatisierungsprojekten konnten Sie bereits sammeln
 Mit MS-Office-Anwendungen können Sie routiniert im Arbeitsalltag arbeiten
 Sie gehen Aufgaben strukturiert an, denken lösungsorientiert und haben die Anforderungen Ihrer Kunden stets im Blick
 Sie übernehmen gerne Verantwortung, arbeiten selbstständig und schätzen die Zusammenarbeit in einem engagierten Team
 Das bieten wir Ihnen: 
 Es erwartet Sie ein erfolgreiches mittelständisches Unternehmen mit über 850 Mitarbeitenden, das für Stabilität, langfristige Perspektiven und eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit steht
 Durch unser Patenprogramm ermöglichen wir sowohl Berufseinsteigern als auch erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden einen sicheren und begleiteten Einstieg in Ihre neue Aufgabe
 Freuen Sie sich auf abwechslungsreiche Projekte sowie eine moderne, technische Ausstattung, die optimale Voraussetzungen für ein effizientes Arbeiten schafft
 Je nach Aufgabe und persönlicher Entwicklung können Sie Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und Projekte aktiv mitgestalten. Unsere Weiterbildungsangebote unterstützen Sie gezielt dabei
 Neben einem unbefristeten Arbeitsverhältnis profitieren Sie von attraktiven Zusatzleistungen wie Dienstrad, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, Zeitwertkonto, aktive Mittagspause sowie Firmen- und Teamevents
 Mit einer attraktiven Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld bieten wir Ihnen zusätzliche finanzielle Vorteile und Planungssicherheit

 Mainz

 Kim Stockmann | Tel. +49 6348 611-345

Die Abteilung „Fabrikation – Forschung und Entwicklung“ am Fraunhofer-Institut für Siliziumtechnologie ISIT bildet das Herzstück der technologischen Umsetzung von Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten in der Mikrosystemtechnik und Leistungselektronik. Sie ist unterteilt in vier Gruppen, die die Planung und Erstellung von Fertigungsanweisungen, die Ausführung der MES-gesteuerten Fertigung im Reinraum sowie die Wartung und den bedarfsgerechten Ausbau ihrer Halbleiterfertigungsanlagen vereinen.
Die Gruppe „Prozessentwicklung und Fertigung“ ist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Einzelfertigungsprozessen auf industriellen Halbleiteranlagen und die Herstellung mikromechanischer und leistungselektronischer Bauelemente auf Si-, Glas- und GaN-Substraten im Reinraum II des Fraunhofer ISIT. Dies schließt auch eine kontinuierliche Überwachung und Analyse der Prozessqualität und -ergebnisse ein. Für diese Gruppe suchen wir einen engagierten wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeiter / Prozessingenieur (all genders) im Bereich der Lithographie. 
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Sie betreuen gemeinsam mit weiteren Teammitgliedern moderne Produktions-anlagen im Photolithographiebereich unseres Reinraums.
 Sie entwickeln neue und optimieren vorhandene Lithographieprozesse an unseren Steppern, Mask-Aligner, Resist-Coater / Resist-Developer.
 Sie wirken gemeinsam mit unseren Integratoren in Entwicklungs- und Fertigungsprojekten bei der Implementierung neuartiger Verfahren und Prozesse mit.
 Zur Sicherstellung der Anlagen- und Prozessverfügbarkeit im Photolithographiebereich stimmen Sie sich mit dem Equipmentserviceteam ab und koordinieren die Verfügbarkeit von Verbrauchsmaterialien in Ihrem Bereich für eine optimale Arbeitsfähigkeit und reibungslose Abläufe.
 Gegebenenfalls stimmen Sie sich mit anderen Fertigungsbereichen im Reinraum ab, um so eine Abarbeitung zeitkritischer Prozessabfolgen sicherzustellen.
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 Ein abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium in Physik, Materialwissenschaften, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Disziplin
 Fundierte Kenntnisse und Praxis in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche:
 (Lithographische) Fertigungsverfahren der Halbleitertechnologie
 Statistische Methoden zur Prozessbewertung
 Entwicklung von komplexen MEMS und/oder leistungselektronischen Halbleiterbauelementen / Prozessen
 Gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift
 Ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative, Einsatzbereitschaft und die Fähigkeit, sich schnell in neue Problemstellungen einzuarbeiten und im Team Verantwortung zu übernehmen
 Für eine stetige Verbesserung des Teams bringen Sie gute Ideen mit, setzen diese nach Absprache mit dem Team und der Gruppenleitung um und bewerten ihre Wirksamkeit.
 Vor allem aber bringen Sie eine Begeisterung für technisch-wissenschaftliche Themen mit starkem Anwendungsbezug mit und bereichern damit unsere Abteilung.
 Was wir für Sie bereithalten 
 Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung zur Unterstützung der Vereinbarkeit von Privatleben und Beruf
 31 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr
 Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement und betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL)
 Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket
 Kostenlose Mitarbeiterparkplätze
 Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
 Es erwartet Sie ein hochmotiviertes Team an Mitarbeitenden in einer innovativen und professionellen Fertigungsumgebung.
 Ein engagiertes Führungsteam und das Kollegium begleiten Sie, unterstützen Sie aktiv bei Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung und sorgen dafür, dass Sie sich schnell in Ihrem neuen Aufgabenbereich zurechtfinden.
 Sie können sich auf eine offene, kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre freuen. 
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber (all genders) mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. 
 Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle ist vorerst auf zwei Jahre befristet. Wir sind jedoch an einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit interessiert. Anstellung, Vergütung und Sozialleistungen richten sich nach dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD). 
 Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.  
 Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt, und machen Sie einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Ihrer Online-Bewerbung erhalten Sie eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Ihnen, wie es weitergeht.

Herr Dr. Dirk Kaden
dirk.kaden@isit.fraunhofer.de

Frau Vivien Wilkens
vivien.wilkens@isit.fraunhofer.de

Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.
 We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!
 The Role
 You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.
 Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.
 What You'll Work On
 Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.
 Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.
 World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.
 Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.
 Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.
 Who We're Looking For
 A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.
 Your Background

 Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.
 Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare.
 Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale.
 Nice to Have
 Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting.
 Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning.
 Robotics or embodied AI.
 Simulation for data generation.
 What We Offer
 Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.
 Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.
 Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

items.jobTitle: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
items.jobDescription:
Our Mission
 At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.
 We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!
 The Role
 You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.
 This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.
 What You'll Work On
 Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.
 Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.
 Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.
 Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.
 Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.
 Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.
 Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.
 Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.
 Who We're Looking For
 A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.
 Your Background
 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers.
 Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar.
 Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills.
 Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted.
 Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it.
 Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware.
 Nice to Have
 ROS 2.
 Hardware-in-the-loop rigs and bench automation.
 Fleet telemetry and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
 Functional safety or comparable standards work.
 On-prem, air-gapped or defence deployment experience.
 Having been on call for hardware in the field.

 About the Role
 We are looking for a Production Quality Control Engineer to ensure product conformity, reliability and quality throughout the manufacturing process.
 You will work closely with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain teams to implement robust quality controls across mechanical, electronic, and electromechanical assemblies.
 This is a hands-on role, combining shop-floor presence, inspection activities, and continuous improvement in a fast-growing industrial environment.
Role & Missions
Production Quality Control
 Define and implement incoming, in-process and final inspection procedures.
 Establish inspection plans, checklists and acceptance criteria.

 Validate product conformity before production release and shipment.
 Process Quality & Continuous Improvement

 Conduct root cause analysis (8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa, FMEA).
 Monitor quality KPIs, defects, rework and production yield.
 Work with Engineering and Manufacturing to prevent recurring issues.
 Support industrialisation and production ramp-up.
 Documentation & Supplier Interface

 Define incoming inspection requirements for critical components.
 Coordinate with Supplier Quality and Supply Chain on supplier-related issues.
 Contribute to the development of the Quality Management System and compliance with ISO 9001 / EN 9100 requirements.

 Engineering degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Electronics or Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience.
 3+ years of experience in Production Quality, Manufacturing Quality or Quality Engineering.
 Strong knowledge of inspection methods and manufacturing quality processes.
 Good understanding of electronic assemblies, PCB integration and wiring harnesses.
 Knowledge of IPC-A-610 and IPC-A-620 standards .
 Ability to read engineering drawings, BOMs and technical specifications.
 Familiarity with problem-solving methodologies (8D, 5 Why, FMEA).
 Hands-on mindset, strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Nice to Have

 IPC certification (CIS/CIT).

 Knowledge of ISO 9001 / EN 9100.
 Experience supporting industrialisation and production ramp-up.

items.jobTitle: Doctoral Candidate (PhD) - Simulation of Polymer Lubricant Additives (all genders)
items.jobDescription:
WE IMPACT THE FUTURE — INCLUDING OUR OWN. 
 CHANGE STARTS WITH US. 
 The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft, based in Germany, is one of the world’s leading organizations for applied research. 74 institutes develop pioneering groundbreaking technologies for our economy and society – more precisely: 30,000 people from technology, science, administration and IT. They know: Everyone joining Fraunhofer is willing and able to make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow. 
 At Fraunhofer IWM, 330 employees conduct research on materials and components with the aim of better understanding, developing, processing and using them. In our projects, we bridge the gap between the properties of materials and the durability, safety and function of technical systems. 
 We show ways and solutions for more energy efficiency and sustainability. After all, materials are crucial for climate neutrality, for the careful use of our planet's limited resources and for the sustainable transformation of our economy.
 Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Networks (MSCA-DN) are collaborative research and training programmes funded by the European Union. They offer doctoral candidates from around the world the opportunity to conduct research and pursue a doctoral degree in an international environment. 
 The POLY4EV Doctoral Network, coordinated by the University of Padova in Italy, brings together 18 academic and industrial partners across Europe ( https://research.chimica.unipd.it/poly4ev/ ). The network will recruit 15 doctoral candidates for research projects lasting up to 36 months, focusing on innovative and sustainable polymer materials for electric vehicles. 
 Be part of change 
 Join POLY4EV, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network that will train 15 doctoral candidates (DC) across Europe. At Fraunhofer IWM in Freiburg, DC5 will work on: “Linking atomic structure and function of polymer lubricant additives via simulations”. The project aims to improve understanding of polymer-based lubricants for efficient and sustainable electric mobility. 
 You investigate how the atomic structure of polymer lubricant additives affects lubricant properties, particularly in the case of friction and viscosity modifiers. 
 You develop and apply atomistic and multiscale simulation approaches to investigate relevant structure–property relationships. 
 You analyse simulation data, interpret physical mechanisms, develop physical models and share findings with partners in academia and industry. 
 You collaborate within the international POLY4EV network and participate in its research training and secondments. 
 You present research results, contribute to scientific publications and work towards your doctoral degree. 
 What you contribute 
 A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in physics, chemistry, materials science, engineering or a related discipline. 
 A background in materials modelling and in one or more of the following fields: polymer physics, statistical physics, physical chemistry, lubrication, tribology. 
 Programming and scientific data analysis skills (e.g. Python, machine-learning tools). 
 Experience in molecular dynamics or atomistic modelling especially in the fields of tribology and/or polymers is an advantage. 
 Familiarity with molecular dynamics simulation tools (e.g. LAMMPS), and/or in using high-performance computing centers (HPC) is welcome. 
 Excellent English communication skills. 
 MSCA eligibility: You must not have lived or carried out your main activity in Germany for more than 12 months in the 36 months before recruitment; further consortium requirements apply. 
 What we offer 
 Within the POLY4EV Doctoral Network, the recruited researcher will have the opportunity to work as part of an international, interdisciplinary team of 15 doctoral candidates, based at universities and industrial firms throughout Europe ( https://research.chimica.unipd.it/poly4ev/index.php/research/ ). She/he will be supported by mentors within the DC5 project and will have multiple opportunities to participate in professional and personal development training, including two secondments at POLY4EV partner universities. 
 The research work will be carried out within the “Multiscale Modelling and Tribosimulation” group at Fraunhofer IWM ( https://www.iwm.fraunhofer.de/en/services/tribology/multiscale-modeling-tribosimulation.html ), in close collaboration with the Simulation Group at the Department of Microsystems Engineering (IMTEK), University of Freiburg ( https://uni-freiburg.de/tf-imtek-sim-en/ ), where she/he will be enrolled in the PhD program. 
 Through her/his work, the DC will gain experience in solving complex problems in the fields of tribology, polymer science, and multiscale modelling within a stimulating environment that brings together academic and industry experts from various fields—such as multiscale simulation, polymer synthesis, experimental tribology and rheology—with the common goal of developing innovative polymer materials that enhance the efficiency and sustainability of electric vehicles. 
 Your Opportunities for Growth: 
 You will have access to a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities to enhance your skills, broaden your expertise and advance your career. 
 Always something new: 
 Working at Fraunhofer IWM means contributing to innovative research in an established and internationally recognised research institute. Our flat organisational structures and open, collaborative working culture ensure that you receive the support and guidance you need to thrive. 
 What we offer you: 
 We support a healthy work-life balance through flexible working hours and opportunities for mobile working. To help you manage family responsibilities, we offer emergency childcare services and a dedicated parent-child office, allowing you to respond flexibly to unexpected situations or childcare challenges. You can also enjoy a wide range of employee discounts on events, furniture, clothing and much more. 
 This culture awaits you: 
 At Fraunhofer IWM, we are committed to fostering an open and welcoming working environment where everyone feels valued and included. From employee interest groups and social activities to networking events during our onboarding programme, we offer plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues and become part of our community. 
 Come and experience our working culture for yourself! 
 The position: 
 The position is a full-time, fixed-term doctoral appointment funded through the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (grant agreement 101312540, https://research.chimica.unipd.it/poly4ev/ ). The EU-funded monthly contributions are a living allowance of €4,010 (adjusted by the German country coefficient), a €710 mobility allowance and, if eligible, a €660 family allowance. These amounts are funding contributions, not guaranteed gross or net salary. Individual employment terms, remuneration and social security arrangements are subject to the applicable Fraunhofer rules and will be confirmed during recruitment. 
 We value and promote diversity in terms of our employees’ expertise. We therefore welcome applications from all candidates, regardless of age, sex or gender, nationality, ethnicity, social background, religion, ideology, disability and sexual orientation or identity. Among candidates with equal qualifications, preference will be given to applicants with severe disabilities. 
 Our tasks are diverse and adaptable. We will work with applicants with disabilities to find solutions that provide optimum support for their abilities. 
 With its focus on key technologies that will shape the future and the transfer of research findings into practical applications for business and industry, the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft plays a central role in driving innovation.  
 As a pioneer and catalyst for technological progress and scientific excellence, Fraunhofer actively contributes to shaping the future of our economy, society and the world around us. 
 The weekly working time is 39 hours. This position is also available on a part-time basis. We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability. Our tasks are diverse and adaptable – for applicants with disabilities, we work together to find solutions that best promote their abilities. 
 With its focus on developing key technologies that are vital for the future and enabling the commercial utilization of this work by business and industry, Fraunhofer plays a central role in the innovation process. As a pioneer and catalyst for groundbreaking developments and scientific excellence, Fraunhofer helps shape society now and in the future.  
 Ready for a change? Then apply now and make a difference! Once we have received your online application, you will receive an automatic confirmation of receipt. We will then get back to you as soon as possible and let you know what happens next. 
   Please check the official call and current application status: 
 https://research.chimica.unipd.it/poly4ev/index.php/openings/ 
 https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu/jobs/476916 
 For questions about Fraunhofer IWM, contact our Talent Acquisition Manager Lara Lang via recruiting@iwm.fraunhofer.de or +49 (0) 761 5142-277 . 
 Fraunhofer Institute for Mechanics of Materials IWM  
 www.iwm.fraunhofer.de

 Candidate Requirements

 Ability to understand component specifications and hands-on experience with electronic/mechanical components is a plus.

items.jobTitle: Qualification & Validation Engineer - Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and CSV
items.jobDescription:
Role Overview
 Plan and execute equipment qualification, process validation and computerized system validation (CSV) for GMP pharmaceutical manufacturing, with a focus on tablet coating and its associated automation. Work with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, IT and equipment suppliers to bring equipment and systems into GMP use and maintain their validated state.
 Key Responsibilities
 Equipment qualification and process validation
 User Requirements Specification (URS) and risk assessment. Define the coater's intended use and required operating ranges for spray rate, airflow, inlet temperature and drum speed. Identify functions that can affect product quality and use the risk assessment to set qualification priorities.
 Design Qualification (DQ). Verify that the proposed design meets the approved URS and applicable GMP requirements. Review product-contact materials, cleanability, sensor locations and operating ranges.
 Factory and Site Acceptance Testing (FAT/SAT). Coordinate supplier and site testing, including spray assembly checks and verification of utility connections. Assess and document when supplier test evidence can support qualification.
 Installation Qualification (IQ). Verify equipment tags, components, drawings, utility connections and instrument calibration records against the approved design.
 Operational Qualification (OQ). Challenge equipment controls across the approved operating range, including relevant limits and failure conditions. Verify drum speed, spray rate, temperature control, alarms and interlocks.
 Performance Qualification (PQ) and process validation. Demonstrate reproducible coater performance using representative loads and approved acceptance criteria. Support coating process validation to demonstrate that the process consistently produces tablets meeting predefined quality attributes. Coordinate PQ and process validation activities where justified.
 Computerized system validation
 Define intended use, system boundaries, GMP functions, electronic records and interfaces. Map data flows between PAS-X, SAP and PLC or SCADA systems where applicable.
 Apply a risk-based approach aligned with GAMP® 5. Use the V-model where appropriate to link user requirements, functional and configuration specifications, and verification evidence. Assess supplier capabilities and use risks to patient safety, product quality and data integrity to determine test coverage. ISPE GAMP® 5 Guide, Second Edition
 Define and test controls for recipe versioning and selection, approved parameter limits, operator permissions and electronic batch record completeness. Verify audit trails, electronic signatures, backup restoration and handling of missing, duplicate or failed interface transfers where applicable.
 Prepare validation plans, protocols, traceability matrices and summary reports. Investigate test deviations, document their resolution and coordinate GMP release with authorized approvers once procedures, training and support are in place.
 Maintain the validated state through change control, incident management and periodic evaluations. Assess upgrades, recipe changes and interface changes for GMP impact and define retesting where needed.
 Requirements
 Qualifications
 Degree in engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, automation, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 Hands-on experience with equipment qualification and CSV in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.
 Working knowledge of EU GMP Annex 15 for qualification and validation, Annex 11 for computerized systems, and GAMP® 5 principles.

items.jobDescription:
Chez MBDA, le sens de notre mission est ce qui nous unit : contribuer à la souveraineté des nations et préserver notre sécurité et notre liberté en Europe. Pour y parvenir, la collaboration et la confiance sont essentielles. MBDA doit relever des défis uniques pour répondre aux besoins des forces armées face à de nouvelles menaces. Motivés par les challenges technologiques, nous repoussons les limites de l’innovation, de la science et de la technologie pour développer des solutions au meilleur niveau.
Nous encourageons le dépassement de soi dans un environnement unique qui offre des opportunités à chacun d’entre nous. Ensemble, nous sommes fiers du rôle que nous jouons.
Au sein de la Direction Engineering de MBDA, vous intégrez le Laboratoire d’Essais et Simulations HWIL (HardWare In the Loop) . il s’agit de simulations temps-réel intégrant, dans la boucle, des équipements embarqués de missiles (calculateur, centrale inertielle…). Ce service développe des simulations HWIL permettant la réalisation d’essais pour tester et valider ces équipements ainsi que les algorithmes embarqués dans des conditions simulées très proches des conditions de vol (scènes extérieures représentatives du champ de tir). La finalité est notamment de participer à la validation des systèmes MBDA en s’assurant de l’adéquation entre les performances attendues et les performances réelles.
Au sein de l'entité Simulations HWIL , dans une équipe d’une vingtaine de personnes, vous réaliserez les campagnes d’essais et serez progressivement en charge de développements, mises au point et validation d’installations complexes.
 Exploitation D'une Installation HWIL Avec
 Intégré à une équipe projet de 2 ou 3 personnes, bénéficiez d’un accompagnement au quotidien vous permettant de monter en compétence sur le métier HWIL au travers les thématiques suivantes :
 Définition des scénarios d'essais,
 Configuration de l'installation et mise en place des équipements missile à tester,
 Réalisation des essais, analyse des résultats et rédaction des rapports d'essais,
 Développement Des Installations De Simulation Au Travers
 Conception et définition des éléments d'une installation d’essais,
 Rédaction des spécifications,
 Réalisation, intégration, validation et maintenance des sous-ensembles HW/SW de l'installation d’essais,
 Gestion des configurations HW&SW,
 Participer aux rituels de management de projets HWIL permettant :
 Suivi du planning,
 Identification, remontée et évaluation des risques.
 Grâce à Votre Formation D’ingénieur Ou Équivalent BAC+5 Et à Vos Premières Expériences (même Projet École/apprentissage, Perso …), Vous Avez Développé Des Compétences à Minima Dans L'un Des Domaines Suivants Et Êtes Intéressé(e) Pour Progresser Sur D'autres Domaines Techniques
 Informatique industrielle : Développement d'applications temps réel, C/C++, OS Linux,
 Electronique industrielle : Electronique analogique/numérique, traitement du signal, interfaces électriques, bus numériques, RF/HF,
 Votre intérêt pour les phénomènes aéronautiques (mécaniques du vol, aérodynamique, notions de Pilotage/Guidage/Navigation, ...) et leur compréhension sont un plus qui vous permettrons d'apporter un regard critique sur les simulations réalisées.
Des connaissances en hyperfréquence (antennes, radars) et ou en VHDL seraient un plus.
Compte tenu de l'environnement international de la société, un bon niveau d'anglais est requis.
 Établissement soumis à enquête administrative conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du code de la défense et de l’IGI n°1300 du 09 août 2021. 
 Evoluer dans un environnement matériel et technologique particulièrement innovant tourné vers les produits du futur,
 Avoir la liberté de choisir des solutions de hautes technicités et de les mettre en œuvre,
 Intervenir dans un environnement type labo avec une partie expérimentale.
 Multidisciplinarité et développement de nouvelles compétences grâce à un accompagnement au quotidien durant les premières années
 Dans le cadre d’une mobilité géographique, nous proposons un accompagnement personnalisé afin de faciliter votre installation, pouvant inclure un soutien au déménagement, ainsi qu’un appui dans la recherche de votre logement, d’écoles et d’activités sportives et/ou culturelles mais aussi une aide à la recherche d’emploi pour votre conjoint(e).
Ces dispositifs sont étudiés selon votre situation individuelle et votre lieu de résidence actuelle.
Notre rémunération comporte un salaire fixe et des éléments additionnels individuels (une part variable pour nos salariés cadres et une prime d’ancienneté ainsi qu’une prime annuelle pour nos salariés non-cadres) ou collectifs dépendant de la performance et des résultats de l’entreprise (participation, intéressement).
De nombreux services/avantages sont également proposés : restaurant d’entreprise, épargne salariale (PEG, PERCOL), protection sociale (mutuelle et prévoyance), comité social et économique, infirmerie et service de santé au travail interne...

We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
 You Are
 You have spent years in the trenches of high-frequency electromagnetics, working on problems where a few picoseconds or a milliohm of impedance mismatch can sink a product launch. You know the difference between a simulation that looks good in a demo and one that actually predicts what happens when the board powers up. Your expertise is not just theoretical, you have debugged real signal integrity issues, traced crosstalk through dense PCB stackups, and explained why an eye diagram closed to a hardware team at 2 a.m. before tapeout.
 Working directly with customers energizes you. You do not just answer questions, you dig into their design context, understand what they are actually trying to solve, and help them get there. You can sit with a senior engineer at a customer site, walk through their workflow in Ansys or similar tools, and leave them more capable than when you arrived. You are equally comfortable presenting to a room of 50 people or pair-debugging a tricky S-parameter extraction with one engineer over a screen share.
 You bring a builder's mindset to every engagement. When a customer hits a wall, you do not just file a ticket, you work with product teams to turn that pain point into a feature. At Synopsys, you will work with some of the most demanding customers in semiconductors and electronics, and what you deliver will directly shape how they design the next generation of hardware.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Provide deep technical support to customers using Ansys electromagnetics simulation tools, diagnosing complex signal integrity, power integrity, and high-frequency design issues across PCB, package, and connector domains
 Engage directly with key accounts to scope, architect, and deliver electromagnetic solutions that fit into their existing design workflows and toolchains
 Deliver intermediate and advanced training sessions, webinars, and technical presentations on signal integrity analysis, S-parameter modeling, impedance simulation, and compliance standards like PCIe, DDR, USB, and Ethernet
 Scope and execute professional services projects in collaboration with cross-functional application engineering teams, translating customer requirements into delivered solutions
 Gather detailed customer feedback on simulation workflows and product gaps, working closely with Ansys product development teams to influence roadmap and feature prioritization
 Test and validate new Ansys software releases against real-world industrial problems, providing structured feedback to engineering teams and supporting beta customer deployments
 Participate in internal technical forums and knowledge-sharing initiatives, contributing best practices and cross-disciplinary expertise across the applications engineering organization
 Travel up to 25% to customer sites, training events, and project engagements across the United States
 The Impact You Will Have
 Accelerate time-to-market for customers by enabling them to solve signal and power integrity challenges faster and with higher confidence
 Drive broader adoption of Ansys simulation tools by demonstrating real value in customer workflows, directly contributing to account growth and renewal
 Improve product quality and usability by translating frontline customer pain points into actionable product requirements that shape future releases
 Elevate customer satisfaction and loyalty through high-touch technical engagement, building long-term relationships with engineering teams at strategic accounts
 Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as a trusted technical partner in the semiconductor and electronics design ecosystem
 Contribute to a culture of technical excellence within the applications engineering team by sharing expertise, mentoring peers, and documenting best practices
 Support revenue growth by enabling pre-sales technical engagements, proof-of-concept projects, and solution demonstrations that close deals
 What You'll Need
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with emphasis on high-frequency electromagnetics, or a related technical discipline
 5+ years of hands-on experience in an engineering software environment, with direct use of Ansys HFSS, SIwave, Q3D, or similar electromagnetic simulation tools
 Deep expertise in signal and power integrity simulation, including crosstalk analysis, impedance control, S-parameter extraction, and eye diagram analysis
 Strong working knowledge of circuit-level and timing analysis for signal integrity applications, and familiarity with compliance standards like PCIe, DDR, USB, and Ethernet
 Practical experience with package, PCB, and connector design processes, and comfort working alongside EDA tools such as Cadence Allegro, Mentor Xpedition, or Altium
 Solid understanding of microwave and antenna fundamentals, including wave propagation, scattering parameters, and transmission line theory
 Proven ability to deliver technical training, present to engineering audiences, and facilitate webinars or workshops. Experience with Agentic AI applications and implementation is a strong plus
 U.S. citizenship preferred due to customer engagement requirements
 Who You Are
 You can walk into a customer meeting, quickly assess the technical problem and the person's experience level, and adjust your approach on the fly without losing clarity or depth
 You are comfortable saying 'I don't know, but I'll find out' and then actually following through, you do not bluff your way through gaps in knowledge
 You think in workflows, not just features. When a customer asks for help with a simulation, you are already thinking about how it fits into their broader design process and what comes next
 You are organized enough to juggle multiple customer engagements, internal projects, and product feedback loops without dropping threads or missing commitments
 You enjoy teaching. Whether it is a one-on-one screen share or a 50-person webinar, you get satisfaction from helping someone understand something they did not before
 You can explain a complex tradeoff between simulation accuracy and runtime to a senior engineer in two sentences without losing the nuance, and you know when to go deeper and when to move on
 The Team You'll Be Part Of
 You will join a team of nine applications engineers with a broad range of experience, from recent hires learning the ropes to advanced engineers who have been solving electromagnetics problems for years. The team is distributed and collaborative, working closely across accounts and technical domains to support customers and share knowledge. Wade, your manager, is hands-on and directly involved in customer engagements and hiring as the team continues to grow. This is a team that values technical depth, customer impact, and learning from each other.
 Rewards and Benefits
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
 At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. 
 In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary bonuses. Synopsys offers comprehensive health, wellness, and financial benefits as part of a competitive total rewards package. The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of job-related factors, including location, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details on the total rewards package upon request. The base salary range for this role is across the U.S.

Ihr Verantwortungsbereich:
Für ein technologisch anspruchsvolles Kundenunternehmen suchen wir im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit langfristiger Perspektive einen **Embedded Software Test Engineer (m/w/d)**.
In dieser Position entwickeln und automatisieren Sie Testlösungen für Embedded-Software und tragen damit maßgeblich zur Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit komplexer technischer Systeme bei. Dabei arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen Software, Hardware und Systemintegration und begleiten den Testprozess von der Konzeption bis zur automatisierten Auswertung.
- Sie **entwickeln, implementieren und validieren Testkonzepte** für Embedded-Software und stellen deren zuverlässige Umsetzung sicher.
- Bei der Realisierung der Testkonzepte arbeiten Sie eng mit **internen Fachbereichen und externen Entwicklungspartnern** zusammen und unterstützen diese bei technischen Fragestellungen.
- Sie entwickeln **automatisierte System- und Softwaretests** und setzen dabei etablierte Testmethoden wie beispielsweise **Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL)** ein.
- Mithilfe moderner Testmethoden und Technologien arbeiten Sie kontinuierlich daran, die **Testqualität und Testabdeckung der Softwaresysteme** zu erhöhen.
- Sie konzipieren, implementieren und erweitern **End-to-End-Testsysteme** für eine möglichst durchgängige und zuverlässige Systemvalidierung.
- Sie überwachen automatisierte Testläufe, analysieren deren Ergebnisse und sorgen für eine **strukturierte und nachvollziehbare Testauswertung**.
- Darüber hinaus entwickeln Sie die **automatisierte Erstellung von Testberichten** weiter und dokumentieren sowie optimieren bestehende Testabläufe kontinuierlich.
Ihr Profil:
- Sie verfügen über einen technischen Abschluss, beispielsweise in **Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Mechatronik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fachgebiet**, oder bringen eine vergleichbare Qualifikation durch entsprechende Berufserfahrung mit.
- Sie besitzen fundierte Erfahrung in der **Entwicklung und Automatisierung hardwarebezogener Softwaretests**, idealerweise im Umfeld von Embedded-Systemen.
- Die Entwicklung automatisierter Softwaretests mit **Python und pytest** ist Ihnen aus der praktischen Anwendung vertraut.
- Sie haben Erfahrung mit **Azure DevOps** und wissen, wie automatisierte Tests sinnvoll in **CI-Pipelines** integriert werden.
- Idealerweise haben Sie bereits mit **Test-Frameworks zur Automatisierung von Funktionstests in der Embedded-Softwareentwicklung** gearbeitet.
- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für **Systemintegration** und gehen bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen strukturiert und systematisch vor.
- Eine hohe Eigenmotivation, selbstständiges Arbeiten und Eigeninitiative zeichnen Sie ebenso aus wie Ihre Freude an der **Zusammenarbeit im Team**.
- Gute **Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse** in Wort und Schrift runden Ihr Profil ab.
Was Sie erwartet:
- Sie erwarten anspruchsvolle und vielfältige Herausforderungen bei unserem aus der Hochtechnologie stammenden Kunden.
- Sie erhalten einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und haben die Möglichkeit bei guter Arbeit übernommen zu werden.
- Sie erhalten einen übertariflichen Lohn, werden auf Basis einer 35h/Woche eingestellt und Ihre Überstunden können Sie sich als Zeitausgleich nehmen oder diese auszahlen.
- Sie erhalten eine persönliche Betreuung durch unsere Niederlassung und Kollegen, die für Sie jederzeit erreichbar sind und Sie, wenn möglich, gerne zu anstehenden Terminen und Gesprächen begleiten.
- Sie bekommen eine umfangreiche Einarbeitung in Ihr neues Aufgabengebiet durch unseren Kunden vor Ort.
- Unser Kunde lebt eine offene und transparente Kommunikationskultur.
- Wir stehen für einen diskreten und vertrauensvollen Umgang mit Ihren persönlichen Daten nach den Richtlinien der Datenschutz Grundverordnung.

- zielgerichtetes, wirtschaftliches Denken und Handeln
- praxis- und ergebnisorientiertes Arbeiten
- dienstleistungsorientiertes Auftreten
