items.jobDescription:
#### About us
Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
#### Job description
In order to support our Overall Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) Design Team**,** Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a
# **Eurodrone Overall RPAS Design Chief Engineer (d/f/m)**
Are you passionate about shaping the future of Airbus Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) products? Join our Overall Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) Design Team for Eurodrone and contribute your skills and enthusiasm to our dynamic Chief Engineering Organization. As such, execute overall design and steering activities to ensure a consistent RPAS design and integration across all functions and through the entire lifecycle, compliant with top level system requirements.
This position focuses on the integration of overall system design and steering activities within the RPA.
**Your location**
Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.
**Our Benefits for You**
- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
**Your tasks and responsibilities**
- Optimize design for the overall RPAS and ensure integration of all level 1 sub-products.
- Perform trades & candidate aircraft configurations associated to RPA and flight chain architectures & requirements.
- Steer significant systems topics requiring a particular synchronization and arbitrating, when required.
- Integrate and coordinate Environmental, EME & Tempest, Electrical, RAMT, Predictive Maintenance, Thermal and Electrical Loads at the RPA level
- Support coordination of the flight chain (safety critical chain) design and testing activities.
- Assess the consequences of technical Change Requests on overall RPAS systems architecture
- Ensure RPA compliance with airworthiness and safety, environmental conditions, design maturity, security and RPAS airport operations at the aircraft level.
- Integrate and coordinate Flight Physics activities (performance, HQ, loads, etc.) and drive flight chain consistent solutions into the overall configuration.
- Secure the project schedule to achieve the program milestones, align technical directives to all design teams, ensuring end to end readiness.
- Ensure integration and verification plans and activities to achieve final certification and qualification; from analysis and simulation through systems testing and completed at Flight Test Level.
If you are ready to take on this exciting challenge and make a significant impact on the future of Airbus UAV products, we encourage you to apply.
**Desired skills and qualifications**
- Master of Science in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent.
- Engineering experience > 6 years in related area.
- You have leadership skills and experience in leading technical teams.
- Knowledge in Overall Aircraft Design, Overall System Design and Overall Physical Design.
- Experience in Systems Engineering.
- Experience in the development of Flight Control Systems.
- Experience in the development of DAL-A software.
- Operational knowledge on UAS or aircraft Operation, in particular Automatic Take Off and Landing.
- Proven track record in project management and technical management.
- Excellent coordination and communication skills.
- Goal-oriented mind set and good analytical skills.
- Very strong team player.
- Exceptional English language skills (Negotiation Level).
**Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.**
**Take your career to a new level and apply** [**online**](https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) **now! 
\#MYCYM**
This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth
By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus. 
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.
At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Über uns
 FICHTNER - Engineering for a better tomorrow Seit über 100 Jahren steht Fichtner als unabhängiges Familienunternehmen für Verlässlichkeit, Integrität und eine werteorientierte Unternehmenskultur. Als Ingenieur- und Beratungsunternehmen arbeiten wir an Lösungen für die großen Themen unserer Zeit – von Energie und Umwelt bis zur Digitalisierung. Unsere Projekte verbinden technische Exzellenz mit gesellschaftlicher Relevanz und bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. In internationalen und interdisziplinären Teams profitieren wir von unterschiedlichen Perspektiven – und schaffen so hochwertige, passgenaue Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Sie erwartet ein Arbeitsumfeld, das von Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und klaren Zielen geprägt ist. Wir schaffen Orientierung und übertragen Verantwortung – und bieten Ihnen gleichzeitig die Freiräume, Ihre Stärken wirksam einzubringen und sich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Die Herausforderung Die Arbeitswelt verändert sich rasant – und wir möchten unsere Mitarbeitenden bestmöglich auf die Anforderungen von morgen vorbereiten. Unser bestehendes Personalentwicklungskonzept benötigt ein modernes Update. Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die unser Team verstärkt, bestehende Strukturen neu denkt, moderne Lernformate integriert und ein ganzheitliches, zukunftsfähiges PE-Konzept entwickelt. Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt ist die Konzeption und Einführung eines unternehmensweiten Skillmanagements, das Kompetenzen transparent macht, Entwicklungsbedarfe aufzeigt und die Grundlage für eine bedarfsgerechte, strategische Personalentwicklung schafft.
 Ihre Aufgaben
 Status-Quo-Analyse: Sie evaluieren unsere bestehenden Prozesse, Instrumente und Strukturen in der Personalentwicklung und identifizieren gezielt Optimierungspotenziale. 
 Konzeption & Strategie: Sie entwickeln gemeinsam mit unserem HR-Team ein modernes, Personalentwicklungskonzept (inkl. Kompetenzmodellen, Karrierepfaden und Feedback-Kultur). 
 Skillmanagement konzipieren & einführen: Sie entwickeln gemeinsam mit HR und den Fachbereichen eine praxistaugliche Skillstruktur mit Kompetenzprofilen und definierten Kompetenzniveaus. Sie gestalten die Prozesse zur Erfassung und Aktualisierung der Skills, begleiten die Pilotierung und den schrittweisen Rollout und verknüpfen die Ergebnisse mit gezielten Personalentwicklungsmaßnahmen. 
 Moderne Lernformate: Sie integrieren zeitgemäße Ansätze wie New Learning, Selbstlern-Plattformen, Mentoring-Programme oder Micro-Learning in unsere Strategie. 
 Umsetzungs-Roadmap: Sie erstellen einen praxisnahen Fahrplan für den erfolgreichen Rollout und begleiten die nachhaltige Verankerung im Unternehmen.
 Das sollten Sie mitbringen 
 Qualifikation & Erfahrung: Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. mit Schwerpunkt Personal, Psychologie, Pädagogik oder BWL) sowie über fundierte Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Implementierung moderner Personalentwicklungsstrategien. 
 Skillmanagement & Umsetzung: Sie bringen Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Einführung von Skill- oder Kompetenzmanagementsystemen mit und können Kompetenzanforderungen gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen in praxistaugliche Strukturen und Prozesse übersetzen. 
 Zukunftsblick: Sie kennen aktuelle HR-Trends (z. B. Future Skills, agiles Lernen, KI im Lernkontext) und wissen, wie man diese pragmatisch und bedarfsgerecht in die Praxis übersetzt. 
 Arbeitsweise: Sie arbeiten strukturiert, ergebnisorientiert und teamorientiert.
 Das erwartet Sie bei uns 
 Eine spannende, strategisch relevante Aufgabe mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Einfluss auf unsere Unternehmenskultur. 
 Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine enge, vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe mit unserem HR-Team und der Geschäftsführung. 
 Verantwortung & Flexibilität: In Ihrer Arbeit genießen Sie hohe Freiheitsgrade und Eigenverantwortung. Zudem bieten wir Ihnen ein flexibles Gleitzeitmodell und 30 Urlaubstage (bei Vollzeitanstellung). 
 Modernes Arbeiten: Wir stellen Ihnen eine moderne digitale Infrastruktur für mobiles und flexibles Arbeiten zur Verfügung. 
 Miteinander & Unternehmenskultur: Ob beim bereichsübergreifenden Austausch in unserer Betriebskantine oder bei unseren regelmäßigen Teamevents – wir pflegen einen starken Zusammenhalt und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Wenn Sie Teil unseres Teams werden möchten, bewerben Sie sich einfach in wenigen Schritten über unser Portal. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

At go-e, we have been pursuing the development of our vision with passion and strength from the very beginning. We are moving in an area that is characterized by breakthroughs and growth and that requires a lot of personal responsibility and creative solution finding. On our journey towards the energy transition, the mixture of innovation and security, regional and international, self-realization and professionalism is the ideal fuel for our mutual growth.
Help build the Portal, a modern web platform for fleet managers and technicians. As a Frontend Engineer (m/f/x) , you will turn product ideas into responsive, accessible interfaces using React and TypeScript. Join a collaborative team that values autonomy, ownership, code quality, and learning, and deliver features with visible customer impact.
With your contribution, you will impact how people will charge their cars in the future. Come and join the team in Berlin (GER) that is building the future of innovative charger solutions for e-mobility!
Your area of responsibility
 Build and deliver frontend features for the Portal using React and TypeScript.
 Work with product, design, and backend specialists to translate requirements into user interfaces.
 Integrate RESTful APIs and WebSocket communication, including asynchronous data, caching, and error handling.
 Write clean, maintainable, performant code and unit and integration tests.
 Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and frontend architectural decisions.
 Troubleshoot existing features, improve performance, and share knowledge with other engineers.
 Who we're looking for :
 Strong experience building web applications with React and TypeScript.
 Experience with server-side rendering frameworks such as Next.js.
 Proficiency with modern frontend tooling and state management, such as Redux or React Context.
 Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, CSS-in-JS or styled-components, and responsive or adaptive design.
 Familiarity with UI component libraries, design systems, and accessibility best practices.
 Experience with frontend build tools such as Webpack, Vite, or Babel, including bundler optimization.
 Ability to integrate APIs and WebSocket communication and manage asynchronous data flows, errors, and caching.
 An independent approach, ownership of your work, and clear communication with product, design, and engineering colleagues.
 Even better would be
 Experience writing developer tools, internal packages, or SDKs.
 Contributions to open-source projects.
 Experience in startup or fast-paced environments.
 Deeper familiarity with real-time or WebSocket architectures.
 (Not a must) Proficiency in one or more backend languages / frameworks (e.g. Node.js / Express / NestJS / TypeScript, or similar)
 What we offer
 Be one of the key drivers of our core technologies
 A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects
 Flexible working hours
 Mental well-being support via nilo.health
 Employee discounts on our products
 Corporate discounts on a variety of brands
 About go-e
 We are a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility and have developed from a start-up to an internationally recognized player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, Austria, we have already expanded to around 20 European countries. With bold ideas based on our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies today.

We work AI-first: AI agents aren’t an experiment for us, they’re a core part of our everyday engineering.
 As an AI-Native Software Engineer (Human) you use AI agents to build features across repositories, languages and systems that genuinely help our customers. And you always stay accountable for the result: AI writes along, you decide.

 Bring product instincts: question requirements, suggest better solutions and help decide what is worth building.
 Build new features spec-first: define requirements and edge cases, implement with AI, review critically, and ship in small, clean steps.
 Get up to speed quickly in unfamiliar codebases and languages with AI support, and refactor across repositories.
 Integrate external APIs, cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure) and SaaS tools securely and cleanly, including secrets and access management.
 Own reliability: monitoring, structured debugging and safe releases, so problems are caught before customers notice.

 What we like
 Functional mindset and understanding of Elixir’s process model (processes, message passing, supervision), plus how Phoenix LiveView works. Hands-on Elixir experience is a plus.

 Years of experience as an AI-Native Software Engineer and a solid foundation in clean, testable code
 Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and a healthy skepticism toward unverified output
 Experience with API and cloud integrations as well as monitoring and debugging in production
 Pragmatism: realistic commitments, raising blockers early, keeping quality high even under time pressure
 Open communication: you raise concerns with data and then fully commit (disagree & commit)

 Excellent English skills; German is a plus
 Our tech stack

 Frontend: Phoenix LiveView, Next.js, React

 What you like
 AI-first engineering: A team that thinks AI-first and gives you room to try new tools and workflows, with real impact on a product used daily by companies and venues.

 Well taken care of: The obligatory fruit basket, a muesli bar and cold and hot drinks are available to you at any time.
 Your choice of hardware: You decide whether you work on a Mac or a Windows device.
 Working hours: Every team works a little differently – but as a general rule, our core hours are 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., and we meet in the office four times a week. The rest is up to you and your own rhythm.
 An office with a wow factor: You work with a view of the Elbe and some of Hamburg’s most beautiful landmarks.

 Growth: We support your development with a learning budget of €300 per year.
 Taking care of your future today: You receive up to €100 per month towards your retirement and savings goals (company pension & capital-forming benefits).
 Your contact person
 Hellen, our Talent Acquisition Manager

SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.
 We’re seeking a Research Engineer to push the quality of our 3D reconstruction. You should have command of the latest scene representations, such as Gaussian splats and radiance fields, and of reconstruction methods across the full range, from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. We are looking for someone who knows the field well enough to choose the right representation and method for a problem, build it, and then make it better. This is a hands-on role for an engineer with deep reconstruction knowledge and strong coding skills.
 Responsibilities 
 Advance the quality of 3D reconstruction, from research ideas to working methods.
 Work across the full range of reconstruction problems, including geometry, appearance, materials and lighting, sparse or incomplete observations, dynamic scenes, and large-scale environments.
 Build and improve reconstruction methods across the full spectrum, from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models.
 Stay at the frontier of scene representations, implement new ones as they appear, and adopt or extend them where they win.
 Tune losses, priors, and optimization strategies to improve fidelity, robustness, and efficiency.
 Build rigorous evaluations on public and internal benchmarks, and use them to drive decisions.
 Collaborate with research and engineering colleagues to bring successful methods into production systems.
 Key qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or equivalent experience, in computer science, computer vision, graphics, or a related field.
 Deep, hands-on knowledge of modern scene representations, for example Gaussian splats and radiance fields, and the ability to weigh their trade-offs.
 Hands-on experience across the reconstruction spectrum, from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models.
 Solid understanding of multi-view geometry, camera models, and rendering.
 Strong experience with deep learning frameworks, including large experiments and comparisons you can defend.
 Strong coding skills, and the ability to take a method from a paper to a working implementation.
 A PhD or publications in reconstruction are a plus, not a requirement.
 At SpAItial, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process.

Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! 
 Jouw rol 
Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance.  What we would love to see from you:

 Fluency in English.

items.jobDescription:
Unser  PreMaster Programm  ist ein zweistufiges Qualifizierungsprogramm  für engagierte Bachelor-Absolvent:innen , die das Ziel haben ein Masterstudium zu absolvieren. Nach dem Bachelor bietet die erste Phase bis zu  12 Monate praktische Erfahrung , um die fachlichen und unternehmerischen Zusammenhänge kennenzulernen. Die zweite Phase umfasst das eigenständige Masterstudium an einer Hochschule / Universität deiner Wahl. In diesem Zeitraum gibt es weitere Events und Seminare sowie persönliche Betreuung durch einen / eine Mentor:in auf dem Weg zu deinem Abschluss. Ebenfalls hast du während deines Studiums die Möglichkeit dich als studentischer / studentische Mitarbeiter:in in das Unternehmen einzubringen.
 Als Teilnehmer:in in unserem PreMaster Programm bist du Mitglied unseres  ctrlX Drives Hardware Entwicklungsteams. 
 Als Teil der ctrlX Drives Hardware-Entwicklung wirkst du bei der Entwicklung von Hardwarelösungen für unsere Antriebsregler mit.
 Dabei entwickelst und optimierst du Schaltungen im Bereich der Leistungs- und Steuerelektronik.
 Du programmierst hardwarenahe Softwarekomponenten (z. B. in C/C++) zur Ansteuerung von Peripherie, Treibern (BSP) und Mikrocontrollern bzw. DSPs/FPGAs.
 Ergänzend unterstützt du bei der Validierung der entwickelten Hardwarelösungen und trägst so zu deren erfolgreicher Umsetzung bei.
Ausbildung : überdurchschnittlich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor) im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Technische Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit dem Ziel, ein Masterstudium aufzunehmen
 Erfahrungen und Know-how : erste Erfahrungen in der C/C++-Programmierung für Mikrocontroller und in der Hardware-Entwicklung, idealerweise von Steuer- oder Leistungsteilen für Antriebsregler, ergänzt durch ein grundlegendes Verständnis analoger und digitaler Schaltungstechnik und Kenntnisse in der Steuerungs- und Automatisierungstechnik, sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in agilen Teams
 Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: selbstständige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, strukturiertes und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten im Team
 Sprachen : sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch
Weiterführende Informationen zum PreMaster Programm:  https://www.boschrexroth.com/de/de/jobs-und-karriere/einstiegsmoeglichkeiten/studentinnen-und-studenten/premaster-program/

 Company Description
 Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.
 But where does that take you? 
 To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.
 And there’s more.  We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.
 Job Description
 We are looking for a 
 Frontend Engineer (Angular) (m/f/d) 
 (unlimited, full-time contract) Join our team at our location in Berlin to build the next generation fintech. 
 Hybrid working conditions available. 
 Work together with our skilled design, product and backend colleagues with the common goal to deliver a truly unique customer and merchant experience that people will love. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.
 We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up.
 Your key responsibilities: 
 You design, build and maintain ambitious web applications as part of a cross-functional team, located at our European sites
 You participate to design, build, and maintain a company- wide platform for interface design and development
 You are part of a cross functional product team and therefore attend regular scrum ceremonies
 You adapt new technical trends in web application to support product’s quality
 You take initiative to improve quality across different aspects of frontend: accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, robustness, etc.
 Qualifications
 What you bring: 
 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with strong hands-on experience in Angular and TypeScript.
 Experience building scalable, responsive web applications and reusable UI components.
 Good understanding of Angular architecture, component-based development, and reactive programming.
 Experience integrating frontend applications with backend APIs.
 Familiarity with frontend testing, debugging, and code quality practices.
 Understanding of web performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.
 A collaborative mindset, ownership of your work, and an interest in continuously improving how we build software.
 Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce.
 Fluent English; German is a plus.
 Please note: you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.
 Additional Information

**Dein Einstieg bei uns in Hamburg**
Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und anspruchsvolle elektrotechnische Projekte auf der Baustelle leiten?
Als **Meister, Bauleiter Elektrotechnik oder Obermonteur (w/m/d)** bist Du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Lieferanten und deinem Team und bringst Projekte im Bereich **Gebäudeautomation** erfolgreich ans Ziel.
### Deine Aufgaben
- Leitung und Koordination elektrotechnischer Projekte auf der Baustelle – von Planung bis Umsetzung
- Sicherstellung termingerechter, budgetkonformer und qualitativ hochwertiger Arbeiten
- Planung und Koordination des Teams sowie Nachunternehmer, effiziente Ressourcennutzung
- Überwachung der Montagearbeiten, Kontrolle der fachgerechten Ausführung, Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften
- Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Lieferanten und internen Abteilungen für reibungslose Abläufe
- Unterstützung des Projektleiters, Aufmaß, Dokumentation und Berichtswesen
### Dein Profil
- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich **Elektrotechnik** (z. B. Elektroniker/in, Elektroinstallateur/in, Elektriker/in)
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in **Baustellenkoordination oder Bauleitung** im elektrotechnischen Bereich
- Kenntnisse technischer Normen und im Lesen von Bau- und Schaltplänen
- Führungsstärke, Organisationsgeschick, professionelles Auftreten
- Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Führerschein Klasse B
### Deine Vorteile bei uns
- **Attraktives Gehalt**, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen
- **Work-Life-Balance**: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten, unbefristeter Vertrag
- **Gesund & mobil**: JobRad, Wellpass & Gesundheitsangebote
- **Mobilität**: Dienstwagenregelung
- **Team & Kultur**: Offene Kommunikation, flache Hierarchien, regelmäßige Teamevents
- **Extras**: Frisches Obst & freie Getränke
**Über uns**
Wir sind ein dynamisches, zertifiziertes Unternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung in der Planung, Umsetzung und Wartung moderner Automatisierungslösungen für Gebäude- und Industrieanlagen. Mit rund 140 Spezialisten und modernster Technik meistern wir selbst komplexe Herausforderungen zuverlässig und maßgeschneidert.
Bei uns erwarten dich spannende Projekte, ein starkes Team und die Möglichkeit, innovative Technologien aktiv mitzugestalten. Werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das auf Qualität, Kompetenz und nachhaltige Zusammenarbeit setzt!
**Jetzt bewerben**
Starte Deine neue Herausforderung noch heute!
Bewirb Dich online oder sende Deine Unterlagen an **bewerbung@glr-gruppe.de**.

This is where your work makes a difference.
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
 Job Summary
 The role of Senior Engineer – Systems & Model Based Design is to contribute in design and development of a product or solution, from conception to design and verification/validation. You will apply expert technical knowledge and engineering principles in the development of products and solutions. You will help accelerate the design and development cycle by employing model-based design principles and developing MATLAB models working together with the hardware and software teams. You will collaborate with a cross-functional team for technical issues, design changes, design reviews, and complex problem resolution.
This position is based out of Bangalore and reporting to the Manager – Systems, Verification & Validation for Patient Support Systems and Global Surgical Solutions divisions. You will need to work collaboratively with cross functions Research & Development teams.
 What You’ll Be Doing
 Identify and define internal and external customer needs, functions, performance, usability and safety requirement for product or solution with thorough knowledge and understanding constraints - Business and Regulatory, Design trade-offs and Risk assessment early in the development cycle working independently or under the guidance
 Use MATLAB to develop Model Based Design working together with hardware and software teams and help accelerate product development cycle.
 Provide your technical expertise to ensure that the project successfully meets cost, quality and schedule targets throughout the product life cycle. 
 Excels in the development of Use Case for product or solution based on intimate knowledge of customers and their environments. 
 Use industry standard tools and excel spreadsheets in the management of requirements and decomposition of system level requirements to modules. 
 Carry out risk management process in accordance with the EN ISO 14971 throughout product life cycle to ensure compliance and product safety. 
 Identify development issues and facilitates in the resolution using optimal technology solutions. 
 Supports in the Usability Engineering activities to ensure the application of human factor in the development of products or solutions to demonstrate compliance to IEC 62366 and FDA guidance. 
 Knowledge in the application of principles of Reliability and Robustness in the development of products or solution. 
 Completes detailed, high-quality technical documentation to capture and communicate designs. 
 Support integration issues during development tests and ensure module / system development is successful. 
 Actively collaborate with software and hardware engineers to aid in the design development.
 Actively engage with verification and validation engineers to aid in the development of verification test plans with good test coverage. 
 What You’ll Bring
 Bachelor's Degree with 6+ years or master’s with 3+years’ experience in Bio-medical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or related field 
 Experience in System engineering function of Medical device/ Medical Imaging / Image processing, with hands on experience developing MATLAB system models.
 Experience in Medical Device development, FDA Regulations and MDR. 
 Exposure to Usability Engineering Process 
 Experience in Quality Function Deployment (QFD), Pugh Matrix, Critical to Quality (CTQ), Design for Reliability (DFR), Design for Excellence / Design for X (DFX) 
 Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with others in a team environment
 Understanding of and adherence to FDA, ISO and IEC design control procedures, regulations and standards. 
 Demonstrated experience in accomplishing objectives. Able to deliver on multiple projects simultaneously 
 Self-motivated with good interpersonal skills

items.jobDescription:
Register your interest below. This is an expression of interest, not a job application, and it does not start an assessment process.
 Looking to start full-time in 2027? Our Graduate Quantitative Researcher (2027 Start) role is currently open. Apply here. 
 If you enjoy using mathematics and code to investigate difficult questions, you could make a direct contribution to Optiver’s success in global markets. As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.
 Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Through constant testing, analysis and refinement, you’ll help our quantitative models adapt as markets evolve.
 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Your onboarding  
 You’ll participate in  Global Optiver Academy , a structured onboarding programme for graduates. It gives new joiners a shared foundation in how Optiver trades, builds systems, and manages risk before they move into their teams. As part of your onboarding, you'll gain exposure to the AI tools and technologies that support research and development across the business. 
 Your responsibilities  
 Depending on the team you join, you'll own the research end to end. That could include:
 Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.
 Working across petabytes of market, order-flow and unstructured data to find signals that improve strategies as conditions change.
 Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.
 Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.
 Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.
 WHO YOU ARE 
 We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. In return, we'll give you the freedom to pursue your ideas and implement them right into our production systems. 
 In terms of skills and qualifications, we're looking for:
 An academic degree in Engineering, Physics, Maths, Econometrics, Computer science or equivalent, with outstanding academic achievements
 Programming experience in any language (preferably Python, but C, C++, Basic, JAVA, etc. are also a plus)
 Ability to apply concepts of probability, calculus and linear algebra
 Competitive attitude and eagerness to constantly improve
 Ability to learn quickly
 Excellent verbal and written English language skills
 WHAT YOU’LL GET 
 You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talent colleagues, working collaboratively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.
 In addition, you’ll receive:
 A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool
 The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 countries
 25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards
 Training opportunities, discounts on health benefits, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses
 Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly chair massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more
 Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events
 Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats
 HOW TO REGISTER 
 Are you interested in furthering your career on one of the most dynamic and exciting trading floors in Europe?
 Complete the short form below with your details and upload your CV in English. Registering your interest is not a job application, and it does not start an assessment process. We'll contact you when we have opportunities that match your profile.
 Kindly note that we do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our recruitment inquiry form. 
 Diversity statement 
 Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion .
 We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via the contact form , selecting "Reasonable Adjustments" as the subject of your inquiry
 For answers to some of our most frequently asked questions, refer to our  recruitment FAQ .
 For applicants based in India, our entry route is via the placement office internship hiring season (July/August).

At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?
 As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.
 This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.
 Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.
 What You'll Work On
 You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:
 Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
 Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
 Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
 Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
 Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
 Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
 Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
 Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
 Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
 Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge
 No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.
 What Success Looks Like
 Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.
 Who We're Looking For
 We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.
 Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning
 No active backlogs
 Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
 Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects
 Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking
 A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly
 Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.
 Our Culture
 More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.
 At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.
 Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

Why Faculty? 
We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here .
 We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.
 Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.
 AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.
 About the team 
   Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions. 
We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.
 About the role 
 Join us as a Software Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse clients.
You will bridge the gap between AI research and real-world impact by building scalable, production-grade machine learning systems. Partnering with clients and cross-functional teams, you will champion technical feasibility, ensure seamless delivery, and collaborate with Frontier Labs to reinforce our leadership in practical, high-stakes AI safety.
 What you'll be doing: 
 Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.
 Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of ML systems and capability testing of Frontier AI models.
 Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.
 Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility and impact.
 Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning at scale.
 Acting as a technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts for stakeholders.
 Who we're looking for: 
 You are comfortable building LLM applications, and are familiar with multi-agent harness tooling and AI Safety evaluation procedures.
 You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.
 You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.
 You've worked with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale
 You are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, and common learning techniques.
 You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
 You're an excellent communicator, able to guide technical teams and confidently advise non-technical stakeholders.
 You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy the autonomy to own scope, solve and delivery solutions
   Our Interview Process 
   Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)
 Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)
 System Design Interview (90 minutes)
 Commercial Interview (60 minutes)
 #LI-PRIO
 Our Recruitment Ethos 
 We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.
 If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?
 As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.
 This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.
 Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.
 What You'll Work On
 You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:
 Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
 Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
 Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
 Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
 Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
 Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
 Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
 Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
 Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
 Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge
 No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.
 What Success Looks Like
 Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.
 Who We're Looking For
 We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.
 Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning
 No active backlogs
 Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
 Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects
 Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking
 A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly
 Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.
 Our Culture
 More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.
 At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.
 Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

We Are Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
 You Are
 You have spent the better part of a decade building analog layouts that do not just pass verification, they perform in real silicon under real conditions. High-speed differential pairs, micro bump planning, die-to-die interconnects, these are not abstract concepts to you, they are problems you have solved repeatedly and refined over time. You know that a transmitter layout that looks clean in Virtuoso can still fail at the package if you did not think three steps ahead about return paths, skew, and substrate coupling.
 You do not treat floor planning as a one-time exercise. You iterate with circuit designers, package engineers, and digital integration teams because you have learned that the best layouts emerge from collaboration, not isolation. When an EM/IR check flags a violation two days before tape out, you do not panic, you debug, you fix, and you close it.
 You have worked on chiplet architectures, 2.5D integration, or advanced packaging, and you understand that UCIe is not just another interface, it is a shift in how we think about die boundaries, signal integrity, and physical partitioning. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that defines how chiplets talk to each other, and the layouts you create will ship in products that matter.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Design and deliver full-custom analog layouts for UCIe PHY blocks including transmitters, receivers, drivers, equalizers, DLLs, bias circuits, calibration engines, and regulators
 Execute PHYTOP-level floor planning, bump planning, micro bump architecture, and channel routing with package co-design considerations for 2.5D/3D integration
 Implement high-speed differential routing with precise length matching, skew control, shielding, symmetry, and signal integrity optimization across die and package boundaries
 Drive physical verification closure including DRC, LVS, ERC, antenna checks, density rules, LPE extraction, EM/IR analysis, and reliability signoff
 Collaborate with ASIC physical design teams to integrate analog layouts into top-level flows, generate LEFs, support place-and-route, and resolve integration issues
 Develop layout methodologies, automation scripts, and reusable design flows that improve efficiency and consistency across the team
 Lead technical reviews, mentor layout engineers, resolve complex cross-domain issues, and drive tape out execution with global circuit design, package, and reliability teams
 The Impact You Will Have
 Your layouts will enable UCIe die-to-die interfaces that ship in chiplet-based products across the semiconductor industry
 The floor plans and bump architectures you create will define how analog PHYs integrate with digital logic, package substrates, and interposers in advanced 2.5D/3D systems
 Your signal integrity work will directly affect whether high-speed channels meet performance targets in real silicon, not just simulation
 The verification methodologies and automation you build will accelerate tape out cycles and reduce respins for future PHY designs
 Your collaboration with package and digital teams will resolve integration challenges that would otherwise delay or compromise product quality
 The engineers you mentor will carry forward the layout practices and problem-solving approaches you establish
 Your contributions will help Synopsys deliver industry-leading UCIe IP that powers the next generation of chiplet ecosystems
 What You'll Need
 Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related technical field
 8 to 15 years of hands-on experience in analog or mixed-signal custom IC layout design
 Proven track record designing layouts for UCIe PHY, high-speed SerDes, or die-to-die interface IP with successful tape outs
 Deep expertise in micro bump planning, bump map architecture, package-aware floor planning, and die/package co-design for 2.5D/3D integration including interposers, RDL, and TSVs
 Strong command of high-speed differential routing techniques including length matching, skew control, shielding, symmetry, and signal integrity-driven layout practices
 Demonstrated experience closing DRC, LVS, ERC, EM/IR, antenna, density, and reliability checks through tape out on advanced process nodes
 Experience integrating analog layouts with ASIC physical design flows, LEF generation, and top-level verification is a strong plus
 Who You Are
 You can walk into a floor planning meeting with incomplete specs, ask the right questions about power distribution and signal flow, and walk out with a layout strategy that works
 When a package engineer tells you the micro bump pitch changed, you do not just update the layout, you think through the implications for channel routing, return paths, and crosstalk
 You have debugged an LVS mismatch at 2 a.m. before tape out and found it was a subtle device matching issue that three other people missed
 You can explain to a circuit designer why their ideal placement will not work given EM constraints, and propose an alternative that meets both performance and reliability requirements
 You keep track of five parallel layout blocks, their verification status, and their integration dependencies without losing sight of the tape out timeline
 You document your work clearly enough that an engineer in a different time zone can pick up your layout, understand the intent, and continue without a handoff call
 Rewards and Benefits
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
 At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

# Ingenieur OTA Experte (m/w/d) Over-the air Software Updates Automotive in Stuttgart 
Du brennst für die Mobilität von morgen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!
Bei PROGNUM sind wir als etablierter Ingenieur- und Beratungsdienstleister darauf spezialisiert, in vielseitigen Automotive-Projekten neue Maßstäbe zu setzen. Wir arbeiten an den wegweisenden Technologien von morgen – sei es im autonomen Fahren, Elektromobilität, Connectivity, Infotainment oder darüber hinaus.
Sichere Dir die Pole-Position und starte mit uns durch!
## Was Dich erwartet:
Als etablierter Akteur in der Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen für Over-the-Air (OTA)-Updates gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Fahrzeugsoftware mit und arbeiten an der Schnittstelle zwischen Spezifikation, Testautomatisierung und Qualitätssicherung.
- Spezifikation von Steuergeräteverhalten: Erstellung detaillierter Spezifikationen für das Verhalten von Steuergeräten während des OTA-Update-Prozesses, inklusive Definition von Abläufen, Zuständen und Schnittstellen.
- Ableitung von Testspezifikationen: Entwicklung umfassender Testspezifikationen unter Berücksichtigung funktionaler, nicht-funktionaler und sicherheitsrelevanter Anforderungen.
- Functional Owner für Testskripterstellung: Zentrale Ansprechperson für die Entwicklung von Testskripten, Koordination der Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern sowie Klärung von Anforderungen.
- Review und Qualitätssicherung: Überprüfung von Testskripten (Python) auf Korrektheit, Effizienz und Konformität mit den Testspezifikationen, insbesondere im Kontext von SOVD (Service-Oriented Vehicle Diagnostics).
- Optimierung von Testprozessen: Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Verbesserung von Steuergerätespezifikationen, Testtools und Testabläufen zur Steigerung der Effizienz und Qualität.
- Testdurchführung und -reporting: Begleitung des Testablaufs sowie Analyse und Optimierung von Testreports zur Sicherstellung der Softwarequalität.
- Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit internationalen Teams, Steuergeräteverantwortlichen und Entwicklungspartnern zur Sicherstellung reibungsloser Prozesse.
## Das bringst Du mit:
- Abgeschlossenes Studium: In Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
- Automotive-Expertise: Kenntnisse der Steuergerätearchitektur und -funktionsweise sowie Erfahrung im Bereich Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates, idealerweise mit Standards wie SOVD und UDS.
- Programmierkenntnisse: Grundlegende Kenntnisse in Python, vorzugsweise im Kontext der Testautomatisierung.
- Testing-Erfahrung: Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Softwaretesting, insbesondere in der Erstellung von Testspezifikationen und Testfällen für Steuergeräte im Automotive-Umfeld.
- Qualitätsstandards: Kenntnisse relevanter Automotive-Standards wie Automotive SPICE sind von Vorteil.
- Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Teams.
- Arbeitsweise: Strukturierte, analytische und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsbewusstsein und Flexibilität.
## Was wir bieten
- Attraktive Vergütung: Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt mit individuellen Zuschüssen und ausgezeichneter Entwicklung nach Tarifvertrag
- High-End Kunden: Zusammenarbeit mit den angesagtesten Unternehmen der Automobilbranche
- PROGNUM-Guide - Das Besondere: Bei PROGNUM lassen wir Sie nicht allein! Vom ersten Tag an begleitet Sie ein persönlicher PROGNUM-Guide vor Ort
- Moderne Arbeitskultur: New Work ist für uns Normalität (z.B. Homeoffice)
- PROGNUM-DNA: Familiär, offen und wertschätzend mit flachen Hierarchien sowie legendären Firmenevents u. After Work Partys
- Spitzen Karriereperspektive: Möglichkeit zur individuellen Weiterentwicklung durch berufsspezifische Trainings
- …und natürlich bieten wir die üblichen Standards wie bis zu 30 Tage Urlaub, BAV, Corporate Benefits uvm.
Bei PROGNUM kannst Du Dein ganzes Potenzial ausschöpfen und aktiv zum Unternehmenserfolg beitragen
## Du möchtest wechseln? Das bleibt unter uns!
Falls Du dich in einem ungekündigten Arbeitsverhältnis befinden, sichern wir Dir natürlich höchste Vertraulichkeit Deiner Bewerbung zu
## Bereit zum Durchstarten? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Möchten Sie die nächste Stufe in Ihrer Karriere erreichen? Bei Brunel haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sich bei namhaften Kunden kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln - und das branchenübergreifend. Machen Sie noch heute den entscheidenden Schritt Ihrer Karriere und bewerben Sie sich bei uns als Homologationsingenieur (m/w/d).
### Ihre Aufgaben
- Durchführung von technischen Bewertungen und Begutachtungen von Fahrzeugen, Fahrzeugteilen sowie Fahrzeugfunktionen nach nationalen, europäischen und internationalen Vorschriften (EU-/UNECE-Regelwerke).
- Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Prüfungen im Rahmen von Typgenehmigungs- und Homologationsprojekten für PKW, Nutzfahrzeuge und innovative Mobilitätslösungen.
- Erstellung von technischen Gutachten, Typgenehmigungsunterlagen sowie EG-/UN-Prüfberichten für Zulassungsbehörden und Kunden.
- Bewertung der Konformität von Fahrzeugen und Komponenten hinsichtlich gesetzlicher Anforderungen, Sicherheitsvorschriften und internationaler Normen.
- Beratung von Fahrzeugherstellern, Zulieferern und Entwicklungspartnern zu regulatorischen Anforderungen und Homologationsstrategien.
- Abstimmung mit Entwicklungs-, Test- und Qualitätsabteilungen sowie Behörden und technischen Diensten.
- Prüfung und Bewertung neuer Fahrzeugtechnologien, Fahrerassistenzsysteme, Softwarefunktionen sowie elektrischer und alternativer Antriebssysteme.
- Unterstützung bei Kundenprojekten vor Ort sowie gelegentliche nationale und internationale Dienstreisen.
### Ihre Qualifikationen
- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Fahrzeugtechnik, Maschinenbau, Automotive Engineering, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.
- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (ca. 4-6 Jahre) im Automotive-Umfeld.
- Idealerweise Erfahrung als:
- Prüfingenieur (m/w/d),
- amtlich anerkannter Sachverständiger (aaS),
- Technischer Dienst,
- Homologationsingenieur,
- Entwicklungsingenieur Fahrzeugtechnik.
- Gute Kenntnisse relevanter Vorschriften und Normen (StVZO, EU-Typgenehmigung, UNECE-Regelwerke).
- Erfahrung in der technischen Begutachtung von Fahrzeugen oder Fahrzeugkomponenten.
- Ausgeprägtes analytisches Verständnis sowie strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.
- Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kunden, Behörden und technischen Ansprechpartnern.
- Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.
- Führerschein Klasse B
### Ihre Vorteile
Wir bieten Ihnen eine Unternehmenskultur, die geprägt ist von der Vielfältigkeit unserer Mitarbeiter sowie von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung - zwischen den Mitarbeitern und auf allen Unternehmensebenen. Dazu gehören neben abwechslungsreichen Stammtischen mit den lokalen Brunel Teams, auch regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche über Ihre Herausforderungen und Perspektiven mit Ihrem Account Manager. Mit individuellen Fortbildungen und Trainings werden Sie optimal gefördert und auf zukünftige Projekte vorbereitet. Unbefristete Arbeitsverträge, 30 Tage Urlaub, Arbeitskontenregelung sowie betriebliche, arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge sind bei uns selbstverständlich.
### Dafür steht Brunel
Arbeiten bei Brunel bedeutet: Attraktive Arbeitsaufgaben, außergewöhnliche Karriereperspektiven, die Sicherheit eines expandierenden Ingenieurdienstleisters und die ganze Vielfalt des Engineerings und der IT. Allein in der DACH-CZ Region verfügen wir über mehr als 40 Standorte und Entwicklungszentren mit akkreditiertem Prüflabor und weltweit über 120 Standorte mit mehr als 12.000 Mitarbeitern in über 40 Ländern. Mehr als 45 Jahre international erfolgreich und über 25 Jahre in Deutschland. Stillstand bedeutet Rückschritt - mit Brunel können Sie etwas bewegen!

items.jobTitle: Test Engineer HIL Autonomy Systems – Land Domain (m/f/d)
items.jobDescription:
About the role:
 We are looking for an experienced Test Engineer – HIL who thrives in the broad spectrum between initial concept, quick prototyping and final validation for cutting-edge autonomy products in the Land Domain . You will drive building and refining our HIL and HW Test Bench infrastructure together with the HW team, and establish automated component- or subsystem-level tests on this infrastructure as an essential part of our overall test strategy.
 What is your Day to Day Mission:
 Design, build and configure HIL test benches, hardware test setups and breadboards based on individual project requirements.
 Develop and maintain automated tests for components and subsystems.
 Integrate relevant hardware, sensors, interfaces and software into the test environment.
 Execute test campaigns and assess the resulting data.
 Define clear pass, fail and invalid test criteria, including for early-stage systems where specifications may still be evolving.
 Analyse test failures and distinguish between actual product issues and problems caused by the test setup.
 Provide engineering teams with clear, actionable feedback based on your test results.
 Collaborate closely with hardware, software, autonomy and systems engineering teams.
 Continuously improve our test infrastructure, processes and overall verification and validation approach.
 What you bring to the team:
 Strong hands-on experience with HIL/HW testing, test benches and test automation, ideally in autonomy, robotics or similar complex systems.
 Solid understanding of sensors, perception, path planning and motion control, combined with the ability to troubleshoot hardware and software integration issues.
 A pragmatic and analytical approach to testing, including defining meaningful test criteria and pass/fail conditions, even when requirements are still evolving.
 A hands-on and resourceful mindset, enabling you to create effective test environments and find practical solutions in fast-moving prototype projects.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills to analyse failures together with engineering teams and translate test results into clear, actionable feedback.
 A self-driven and adaptable working style with the motivation to take ownership and move challenging projects forward.
 Your Benefits: 
 Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 
 Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 
 Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 
 Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 
 Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities. 
 About us:
 Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

Projektleiter Elektroplanung mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum (w/m, 80-100%) 
 Arbeitsort: Zürich West
 Sie möchten anspruchsvolle Elektroprojekte eigenverantwortlich leiten und dabei Teil eines Teams sein, in dem Qualität, Vertrauen und Zusammenhalt wirklich gelebt werden? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen .
 Unsere Mandantin ist ein etabliertes, innovatives Elektroingenieurbüro im Grossraum Zürich mit rund 50 Mitarbeitenden und einem ausgezeichneten Ruf für Qualität und technische Kompetenz. Das Unternehmen plant und realisiert anspruchsvolle Projekte für namhafte Auftraggeber aus Industrie, Forschung, Gesundheitswesen, Bildung sowie dem öffentlichen und privaten Sektor. Die Projekte sind ebenso vielseitig wie die Menschen, die daran arbeiten. Besonders bemerkenswert sind die offene Unternehmenskultur, der starke Zusammenhalt und die gegenseitige Unterstützung über alle Standorte hinweg. Aufgrund des kontinuierlichen Wachstums und zur weiteren Verstärkung des Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Projektleiter, der Verantwortung übernehmen und die Zukunft aktiv mitgestalten möchte.
 Sie haben Freude daran, anspruchsvolle Elektroprojekte selbstständig zu leiten? 
 Sie möchten sich auf die Projektleitung konzentrieren, ohne selbst CAD-Zeichnungen erstellen zu müssen? 
 Sie schätzen ein kollegiales Umfeld, in dem man einander unterstützt und gemeinsam Lösungen findet? 
 Bei Fragen freue ich mich auf Ihren Anruf unter 044 851 40 01
 Ihre neue Aufgabe 
 Sie übernehmen die selbstständige Leitung und Koordination anspruchsvoller Elektroplanungsprojekte von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe.
 Sie tragen die fachliche und organisatorische Verantwortung für Ihre Projekte. Die zeichnerische Umsetzung erfolgt durch das Planungsteam, sodass Sie sich auf Ihre Projektleitungsaufgaben konzentrieren können.
 Sie verantworten die Projektorganisation, Terminplanung, Kostenkontrolle und Qualitätssicherung und behalten dabei stets den Überblick.
 Sie sind kompetenter Ansprechpartner für Bauherren, Architekten, Fachplaner und weitere Projektbeteiligte und vertreten die Interessen Ihrer Auftraggeber.
 Sie koordinieren die internen Elektroplaner und Zeichner, begleiten Ausschreibungen und Vergaben und sorgen für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit aller Projektbeteiligten.
 Was Sie auszeichnet 
 Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroplaner EFZ oder Elektroinstallateur EFZ sowie eine branchenspezifische Weiterbildung, beispielsweise als Elektroprojektleiter mit eidg. Fachausweis, dipl. Elektroinstallateur oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Sie bringen mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Elektroplanung mit und haben bereits anspruchsvolle Projekte eigenverantwortlich geleitet.
 Sie verfügen über fundierte Fachkenntnisse in der Planung elektrotechnischer Anlagen, kennen die relevanten Schweizer Normen und Vorschriften und sind mit den branchenüblichen Planungsinstrumenten vertraut.
 Sie sind ein Organisationstalent, denken unternehmerisch und behalten auch bei komplexen Aufgaben den Überblick. Dabei sind Ihnen Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit besonders wichtig.
 Sie sind eine offene, kommunikative und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, gerne mit anderen zusammenarbeitet und ihr Wissen mit Kollegen teilt.
 Unser attraktives Angebot 
 Aussergewöhnlich vielseitige und spannende Projekte: Sie arbeiten für namhafte Auftraggeber an technisch anspruchsvollen Bauvorhaben und profitieren von einem breiten Spektrum interner Fachkompetenzen. Wenn Sie möchten, können Sie sich auf bestimmte Fachgebiete spezialisieren und Ihr Wissen in einem internen Kompetenzteam einbringen und weiterentwickeln.
 Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem der Mensch zählt: Sie erwartet ein eingespieltes, hilfsbereites Team mit einer offenen Du-Kultur, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer Unternehmenskultur, die von gegenseitigem Vertrauen und Wertschätzung geprägt ist.
 Attraktive Ferienregelung und flexible Arbeitszeiten: Zusätzlich zu Ihren regulären Ferien geniessen Sie vom 24. Dezember bis zum 2. Januar bezahlte Betriebsferien. Auch als Projektleiter unterstehen Sie keiner Kaderregelung bezüglich der Arbeitszeit und profitieren von einer grosszügigen bezahlten Pausenregelung.
 Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Sie profitieren von einer überdurchschnittlichen beruflichen Vorsorge, zusätzlichen Versicherungsleistungen, grosszügigen Spesenregelungen und einem Arbeitgeber, der auch bei persönlichen Anliegen flexibel auf Ihre Bedürfnisse eingeht.
 Moderne Arbeitsmittel und persönliche Entwicklung: Sie arbeiten mit zeitgemässer Technik, erhalten Unterstützung durch interne Spezialisten und profitieren von individuell abgestimmten Weiterbildungen, regelmässigem Wissenstransfer sowie gemeinsamen Teamevents.

 Sehr gerne können Sie mich vorgängig auch unter 079 250 94 99 anrufen.
 Ich freue mich auf unseren Austausch.
 Diskretion ist selbstverständlich!

 Backendservices en API’s ontwikkelen in Python met FastAPI. 
 Werken aan schaalbare applicaties en AI-systemen die zelfstandig tools kunnen gebruiken, informatie ophalen en workflows uitvoeren (agentic). 
 Bouwen aan cloudoplossingen binnen Azure. 
 Nieuwe ideeën snel omzetten naar werkende prototypes en toepassingen. 
 (Online) databronnen ontsluiten en koppelen om te komen tot bruikbare informatie.

 Tooling voor datagedreven analyses die organisaties inzicht geven in hun ontwikkel- en groeipotentieel.

 Een slimme offertetool die automatisch offertes opstelt, analyseert en beoordeelt. 
 Quote 
 "Bij Berenschot krijg je echt de ruimte om te leren, te experimenteren en te groeien. Je werkt direct mee aan AI-systemen die consultants dagelijks gebruiken en leert daarbij van ervaren engineers." – Stagiair bij Berenschot. 
 Hier kom je terecht 
 Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. 
 Dit zijn je directe collega’s 
 Team Digital & Data bestaat uit een groep nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste adviseurs en specialisten. De groep telt ongeveer 25 collega’s: data scientists, data-analisten en ontwikkelaars die met digitale tools adviesopdrachten ondersteunen. De opdrachten variëren van een aanvraagplatform voor zorginstellingen tot een tarievenanalyse voor de kinderopvang. Het team staat bekend om zijn informele en collegiale werksfeer waarin veel ruimte is voor nieuwe ideeën en eigen inbreng. Samenwerking en kennisdeling staan centraal in deze dynamische omgeving. 
 Dit neem je mee 
 We zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste en leergierige stagiair(e):

 Je hebt ervaring met Python. Heb je een GitHub-profiel link of portfolio? Dan zien we die graag terug in je sollicitatie.

 Je hebt basiskennis van asynchronous programming en good software design. 
 Je hebt interesse in AI, generatieve AI en agentic workflows (bijvoorbeeld. met OpenAI en LangChain); ervaring hiermee is een pre. 
 Je hebt interesse in cloudtechnologieën, met name Azure; ervaring hiermee is een pre. 
 Je beschiktover een uitstekend probleemoplossend vermogen en een nieuwsgierige, leergierige houding. 
 Je hebt heldere communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve instelling. 
 Dit bieden we jou 
 Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. De cultuur is informeel, met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en initiatief. 
 Dit is wat we jou bieden: 
 Een parttime of fulltime stageplek van 4 tot 6 maanden. 
 Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltime basis). 
 Een laptop. 
 Flexibele werkmogelijkheden, thuiswerken is mogelijk.
