Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. 
 About the Role
 As a Senior Software Engineer within our Commodities tribe, you will lead the end-to-end integration of US inland waterway barge data into Kpler’s global cargo intelligence platform. Operating under a "you build it, you run it" philosophy, you will design robust ingestion paths, stream real-time data using Kafka, and connect barge movement models directly to our customer-facing surfaces. This role carries genuine design authority, empowering you to solve complex entity resolution problems while mentoring peers and elevating technical craft across our crews.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead end-to-end integration architecture: Drive the full engineering lifecycle—from external feed ingestion and domain modeling to streaming, entity resolution, and UI distribution.
 Design robust ingestion & entity-resolution systems: Map incoming barge data onto Kpler reference data (vessels, zones, installations, products) using existing Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL matching patterns.
 Build scalable Kafka streaming pipelines: Construct event-driven contracts, schemas (Avro), deduplication mechanisms, and dead-letter queue replays with Python and Scala.
 Deliver data across customer surfaces: Surface integrated barge data cleanly across Elasticsearch read models, external APIs, data warehouse feeds, and the Kpler Terminal (TypeScript/Vue).
 Champion production quality & observability: Maintain full operational ownership of your services, setting SLOs, participating in on-call rotations, and driving post-incident improvements.
 Ensure data integrity & analyst alignment: Validate external feeds and integrate human-in-the-loop analyst workflows so corrections seamlessly apply to barge movements.
 Mentor and elevate engineering craft: Guide and mentor crew members, document architectural designs, and actively contribute to decomposing legacy estates into event-driven services.
 Experience & Background 
 What you'll need (Must-haves)
 Production data engineering experience: ~5+ years of experience designing, operating, and maintaining data-intensive production systems with full ownership.
 Advanced Python & SQL expertise: Proven ability to build clean, well-bounded services within large, complex, and evolving codebases.
 Event-driven streaming proficiency: Hands-on experience with Kafka streaming in production, including schema management (Avro/Schema Registry), deduplication, and replay patterns.
 Third-party integration & entity resolution: Demonstrated background integrating external data feeds, managing schema mapping, and building data quality monitoring frameworks.
 Operational mindset: Direct experience managing production observability, writing documentation, and resolving incidents in a distributed system environment.
 Nice-to-haves
 Functional programming & Scala: Experience or familiarity with Scala (Kafka Streams) or a track record of rapidly mastering new languages.
 Geospatial & domain knowledge: Familiarity with geospatial data tools (PostGIS) or exposure to maritime, logistics, or commodities domains.
 Modern data stack exposure: Experience with Elasticsearch, Airflow, Snowflake/lakehouse table formats, Kubernetes, and GitOps deployments.
 UI/Frontend collaboration: Working knowledge of TypeScript or Vue to collaborate on user-facing terminal features.

These include mesh algorithms, mesh data structures, numerical optimization, combinatorial optimization, discrete geometry and topology. Likewise beneficial is extended programming experience, especially in C++.
Scope of Work:
• Research in the context of the DFG-funded research project „SolidMaps 2: Hierarchical Computational 3D Solid Mapping“. Above all, you will work on the design, development, and analysis of novel algorithms for the reliable and efficient computation of bijective maps between 3D objects, on the basis of tetrahedral or polyhedral meshes. Closest prior work includes the articles:
- “Bijective Volumetric Mapping via Star Decomposition”
- “Bijective Maps from Simplicial Foliations”
- “Galaxy Maps: Localized Foliations for Bijective Volumetric Mapping”
- “Stripe Embedding: Efficient Maps with Exact Numeric Computation”
- “Divide-and-Conquer Embedding”
• Publication, presentation, and transfer of research results
• Teaching duties usually amounting to 4 teaching hours (SWS) per week in the areas computer graphics / geometry processing / visualization
Recruitment requirements:
• Scientific university degree (Master or equivalent) in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a closely related subject
• Ph.D. for the postdoc position
• Solid command of written and spoken English
• Solid knowledge in the thematic context of the research project topic
We offer:

• Wide range of health, counseling and prevention services
• Attractive fringe benefits such as childcare facilities and sports activities
• Opportunities for internal and external training and development
• Additional benefits in accordance with the collective agreement of the federal states (TV-L), such as annual bonuses and capital-forming benefits as well as the VBL supplementary pension scheme
Applications from women are particularly welcome and, in case of equal qualifications and experiences, will receive preferential treatment according to to state law (LGG), unless there are preponderant reasons to give preference to another applicant. Part-time employment is generally possible. Applications from disabled people with appropriate suitability are explicitly welcome. This also applies to people with equal opportunities in accordance with the German social law SGB IX.
Please send your application documents (in particular cover letter, CV, certificates and transcripts of record, and possibly recommendation/reference letters), preferably in a single pdf file, using the Ref. No. 7440 until December 06th, 2026 to sek-cgv@lists.uni-paderborn.de.
Questions regarding this position can be directed ahead to Prof. Dr. Marcel Campen (marcel.campen@uni-paderborn.de).
Information regarding the processing of your personal data can be located at:
https://www.uni-paderborn.de/en/zv/personaldatenschutz.
Prof. Dr. Marcel Campen

Paderborn University
Warburger Str. 100
33098 Paderborn

 🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!
   In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.
     Why this role matters at Pennylane 
   As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders.
 You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome.
 This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team.
   Team and Context 
 Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter.
 You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position.
 Key missions 
 Engineering strategy and transversal initiatives 
 Own the strategic, cross-organization initiatives that no single squad can carry: platform or architecture programmes, reliability and quality step-changes, engineering productivity, technical debt paydown
 Frame the problem, build the technical and business case, secure alignment across Engineering, Product and Security to drive execution
 Lead the Tech side of company-level programmes (e.g. European expansion, major compliance or infrastructure shifts) alongside the rest of the Tech leadership
 Planning & Performance tracking 
 Own the Tech planning cycle: collect the inputs, surface the trade-offs (capacity vs. platform, run vs. new bets), and drive the arbitration with Tech leadership
 Drive the definition and calibration of Tech OKRs, and hold the organisation accountable
 Define what "good" looks like for a 70+ squad engineering organization and build the metrics that measure it (delivery cadence, reliability, quality, staffing and attrition, engineering satisfaction)
 Decision-making and leadership cadence 
 Own the Tech leadership operating system: staff meetings, QBRs, roadmap and architecture reviews. You design them, set the agenda, write or commission the pre-reads, frame the decisions to be made, and make sure decisions land
 Maintain the CTO's decision log: what was decided, by whom, with what trade-off, and what happened next
 Raise the quality of decision-making across the Tech leadership team
 Communication 
 Lead internal and operational communications across the engineering organization, building clear messaging systems from board decks down to team-wide updates
 Who you’ll work with? 
 CTO and Tech leadership (Head of Engineering / Head of Data / Senior Engineering Managers)
 Rest of the leadership (CPO, VP Strategic Initiatives)
 Other relevant teams (e.g. Security, Finance, People)
 Who we’re looking for 
 Must-have 
 An engineering degree (engineering, computer science or equivalent scientific curriculum)
 Technical fluency: you can read a design doc, follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate or a trade-off, and be taken seriously by senior engineers
 7-10 years of experience, including significant time inside a tech organisation at scale (multiple squads, platform teams), where you have lived the problems of scaling engineering
 A track record of owning complex, cross-organisational initiatives from framing to measurable outcome with senior stakeholders
 Outstanding written communication: this role produces documents that senior people act on
 Fluency in English
 Nice-to-have 
 A hands-on engineering past: software engineer, engineering manager, Technical Program Manager, architect or equivalent
 Experience as a Chief of Staff, VP/Director of Engineering Operations, or in a strategy & operations function inside a product-led tech company
 What you can expect? 
 Within one month 
 You'll complete the company and Tech onboarding, including our application, accounting domain and engineering practices
 You'll have met the Tech leadership team and formed your own view of where the organisation loses time, quality or alignment
 You'll have taken ownership of the leadership cadence and the next planning milestone
 Within 3-6 months 
 You'll be leading selected org-wide strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a measurable target
 The Tech organisation will have a metrics picture it trusts and uses to make decisions
 You'll be a recognised voice in the senior tech community at Pennylane, consulted on decisions rather than just informed of them
 You'll be shaping the engineering narrative that the rest of the company and the board hear
 Recruitment Process 
 - Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)
 - An interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)
 - An interview with Quentin - CTO (1h)
 - A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)
 - A final interview with Nathan - Head of Product Strat&Ops (45 mins)
 What do we do to make your work life easier 
   🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane
 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package
 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us
 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it
 ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment
 🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone
 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.
   If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)
 We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. 
   Who are we looking for ? 
 To thrive at Pennylane, you need :
 -To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
 -To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
 -To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

   We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.
 If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.
   Important information for candidates

   We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.
 We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

 About us 
 SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.
 SetSales is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.
 What we offer you 
 As our Graduate New Business Executive, you get the unique opportunity to be a key player in building the greatest global conferences by providing you with exceptional training and products. We want to constantly push you out of your comfort zone. You’ll be working out of our HQ in London and to ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:
 A competitive salary and generous OTE
 An opportunity for getting operational experience in a scale-up business where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the businesses
 A chance to work closely together with our leadership team on conference strategies
 Unlimited growth potential in our group - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally
 Your Responsibilities 
 Your mission would be to work closely with our lead generation and senior sales team to generate meetings for our global partnerships managers. In order to be successful, your main duties will include:
 Meeting booking: Work with a team of analysts to both review potential leads and set up meetings for our sales team. You are expected to use a range of outreach methods (phone, email, LinkedIn etc) in order to set meetings with quality prospects

Building a More Resilient World 
 When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.
 We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.
 And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."
 We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.
 About the Role 
 We're looking for an Product Engineer // AI to build the automations that turn claims handling into something the industry has never had: fast, reliable, and actually built for the volume insurance runs at.
 You'll find the automation nobody else saw - liaise with claims handlers, watch where the process actually breaks down, and turn what you learn into the feature that fixes it. Not a backlog ticket — your idea, built and shipped.
 You'll build agents that are actually used, every single day - full-stack, end-to-end, deployed into production where they're doing real work on real claims, not sitting in a demo. Most engineers wait years before their AI systems touch anything real. You'll do it from day one.
 You'll own the risk, not just the code - work shoulder-to-shoulder with AI engineers and ops to make sure what you ship is bulletproof, then keep pushing it further as the system scales. This is the difference between building something clever and building something that lasts.
 We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We're a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.
 Who You Are 
 We care more about hunger and grit than years on a resume. You might come from a product engineering background, an AI/ML team shipping real features, or a startup where you've had to own things end-to-end.
 Comfortable working directly with users to find real opportunities - you don't wait for a spec, you go find out what's actually slow or broken
 Genuine understanding of agentic AI systems - you know how to design AI that takes real actions, not just answers questions
 Fast, capable full-stack builder - you can take a feature from idea to production without waiting on someone else to unblock you
 Obsessive about correctness and risk - you think about what happens when an automation is wrong, not just when it's right
 Our Values 
   Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.
 Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.
 Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.
 Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'
 Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

About Rocket Factory Augsburg
 At Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA) , we have one clear goal: to create low-cost, flexible, and reliable access to space. We specialize in building small launch vehicles designed to deploy satellites into Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and beyond. Together with you, we aim to revolutionize space services and help improve life on Earth. Sounds interesting? Then join our journey and become part of the team driving the New Space movement in Europe. 
 About the Team
 Join a team that is shaping the future of European space transportation. In this role, you will take ownership of the electrical infrastructure that powers launch and test operations, from initial concept development through commissioning and operational readiness.
 You will work on technically challenging projects involving high-reliability power systems, critical infrastructure, and complex industrial environments. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, and construction, you will play a key role in building and maintaining the facilities that make successful launch campaigns possible.
 If you are passionate about turning ambitious engineering concepts into safe, reliable, and operational systems, we would love to hear from you.
 Your Tasks
 Design, build, and commission electrical control systems for launch and test sites, including control panels, I/O, and field wiring.
 Contribute to technical requirements for control systems, instrumentation, and electrical interfaces, working with senior engineers and other disciplines.
 Develop and maintain control system hardware based on Beckhoff PLCs and EtherCAT I/O, from component selection and panel design to integration with sensors, valves, and drives.
 Create and maintain electrical documentation such as schematics, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, and panel layouts, following team standards.
 Carry out installation, I/O checks, testing, and commissioning on site, and support troubleshooting and fault investigation during operations.
 Work with technicians, contractors, and internal teams so systems are built and installed as designed.
 Report progress, flag technical issues and risks early, and give regular updates to the team lead.
 Your Qualifications
 Must-Have Skills 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 3+ years experience designing, building, commissioning, or maintaining industrial control systems.
 Working knowledge of PLC-based automation, ideally Beckhoff based systems; experience with other platforms is also welcome.
 Solid understanding of control panel design, including component selection, LV distribution within the panel, protection devices, cable sizing, and earthing/grounding.
 Familiarity with field instrumentation and actuators (sensors, transmitters, valves, motor drives, VFDs) and their integration into the control system.
 Ability to develop, review, and maintain electrical documentation such as schematics, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, panel layouts, and technical specifications.
 Experience supporting systems through the project lifecycle, from design through installation, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
 Ability to work hands-on with hardware, panel wiring, I/O checks, testing activities, and fault investigation.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
 Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
 Nice-to-Have Skills 
 Hands-on experience from university student engineering teams (e.g. rocketry, Formula Student, CubeSat) or research projects involving real hardware, electrical integration, or testing. Substantial involvement can count towards the experience requirement above.
 Experience with launch, aerospace, energy, process, or other mission-critical industrial environments.
 Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP).
 Familiarity with IEC, BS, or comparable international electrical standards (e.g. IEC 60204-1, IEC 61439, BS 7671).
 Experience with E-CAD tools (e.g. EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical).
 Experience working with contractors or external engineering partners during installation and commissioning.
 We Offer
 Atmosphere: Experience life in an international & dynamic New Space start-up  
 Flexibility: Fit your working schedule to your needs with flexible working hours  
 Home Office: Full-time employees benefit from one day per week home office  
 Health: Sweat, stretch or squat it out with EGYM Wellpass  
 Paid Time Off: 30 days annual leave and speacial leave days   
 Team Culture: Join regular company and team events  
 Parking: Free parking for your car or bike 
 Insights
 Ready to take the next step? 
 Join RFA and help build one of Europe’s most efficient launch systems. Work alongside 300+ colleagues from over 40 countries and take ownership from day one. 
 If you’re looking to grow, take responsibility, and contribute to making space more accessible, we’d love to hear from you. 
 🚀 Apply now!   We look forward to receiving your application in English.

items.jobTitle: Digital Signal Processing Engineer Ranging and Timing (d/m/w)
items.jobDescription:
Tätigkeitsbeschreibung: 
 Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Experten für Timing und Ranging in Kombination mit Datenübertragung, um unsere Laser Terminals fit für die Zukunft zu machen. Als führende Fachkraft treiben Sie die Integration der benötigten Funktionen in unsere optischen Kommunikationssysteme voran. In dieser Schlüsselposition bieten sie die notwendige Expertise zur Definition der PNT-Algorithmen (Pointing, Navigation & Timing) und haben die technischen Gesamtverantwortung als Embedded Systems Manager für die daraus resultierende Systemarchitektur. Sie gestalten die entscheidende Schnittstelle zwischen mathematischer Algorithmik und hardwarenaher Implementierung.
 Aufgaben:
 Definition, Entwicklung und Validierung komplexer Algorithmen für Pointing, Navigation und Timing (PNT) in Satelliten-Konstellationen und Laser-Kommunikationssystemen.
 Erstellung von Referenzmodellen und Simulationen der Algorithmen mittels C-Code zur Verifizierung der mathematischen Modelle.
 Technische Spezifikation und Dokumentation der PNT-Algorithmen als Basis für die Gateware-Spezifikationen.
 Verantwortung und Koordinierung der SW- und GW-Entwicklungen sowie der Verifikation und Inbetriebnahme auf der entsprechenden Hardware.
 Koordination/Generierung des entsprechenden VHDL-Codes zur Implementierung der Timing und Ranging Funktionalität in FPGAs
 Erarbeitung der SW/GW Release-Pläne und Sicherstellung der Konsistenz zwischen Software, Gateware und Hardware Releases.
 Erstellung und Freigabe der zugehörigen technischen Dokumentation
 Ihr Profil:
 Akademischer Abschluss in Nachrichtentechnik, Elektrotechnik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Physik oder Ähnlichem (Master/Diplom/Promotion).
 Expertise im Bereich Navigationsalgorithmen, insbesondere Pointing, Navigation und Timing.
 Tiefe Kenntnisse in der algorithmischen Modellierung (idealerweise C) und der direkten Hardware-Implementierung (VHDL/FPGA).
 Erfahrung in der Rolle als technischer Systemverantwortlicher (Technical Responsible) in komplexen Embedded-Projekten.
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 Erfahrung mit Raumfahrtprojekten ist von Vorteil.
 Was wir bieten
 Eine zentrale Expertenrolle in innovativen Raumfahrtprojekten.
 Die Möglichkeit, die Navigationsarchitektur von Satelliten-Systemen der Zukunft maßgeblich mitzugestalten.
 Ein interdisziplinäres Umfeld an der Schnittstelle von Algorithmen, Software und Hardware.

Tätigkeitsbeschreibung: 
 About Us 
 Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The company is constantly innovating to provide efficient and technologically advanced solutions in aerospace, defense, and connected services. In the commercial aircraft sector, Airbus offers the most modern and fuel-efficient aircraft families. Airbus is also a European leader in defense and security and one of the world's largest space companies. As such, we are actively shaping the technological future to strengthen the security and sovereignty of Europe. 
 About the role 
 Join Airbus to turn open AI models into specialist models that engineers rely on every day. You will post-train, evaluate and optimise models on Airbus data, and hand them over as tested, versioned releases that agent and engineering applications can use in production on our own sovereign infrastructure.
 Location: Munich or Madrid or Toulouse or Paris or Hamburg 
 What you will do 
 Implement the approaches defined with the team’s applied scientists: Post-train open language and multimodal models for engineering tasks through supervised fine-tuning, preference alignment, reinforcement learning and distillation. 
 Build these as reproducible pipelines, not one-off experiments, so every model can be retrained and improved as data and needs change. 
 Design and maintain evaluation suites for Airbus tasks, covering domain accuracy, reasoning, hallucination, robustness and safety, and use them to decide what ships. 
 Optimise models for on-prem use through quantisation, pruning and inference tuning, balancing quality, latency and GPU cost. 
 Release models with clear documentation (model cards, known limits, usage contract) and hand them to the teams that serve and use them. 
 Work with agent and engineering teams to turn their needs into model requirements, and measure the impact of each release (accuracy gained, time saved, cost).
 What you bring ( Required qualifications) 
 Master's degree in computer science, machine learning or a related field. 
 Several years of hands-on experience fine-tuning or training deep learning models and shipping them to real users. 
 Strong Python and PyTorch, with experience in the Hugging Face ecosystem (e.g. Transformers, TRL, PEFT). 
 Experience building evaluation for ML models: benchmarks, test sets and metrics that reflect real use. 
 Solid engineering habits: version control, testing, experiment tracking and reproducibility. 
 Fluent English.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience with preference alignment or reinforcement learning for LLMs (e.g. DPO, GRPO, RLHF). 
 Experience with distillation, quantisation or inference engines (e.g. vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp). 
 Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g. lm-evaluation-harness, Inspect) or LLM-as-judge methods. 
 Distributed training at scale (e.g. FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM). 
 Background in engineering, manufacturing or aerospace data. 
 German language skills.
 What we offer (both roles) 
 The chance to shape how AI is used in aircraft engineering at a world-leading aerospace company, with visible impact on real products. 
 Work on open models and sovereign, on-prem infrastructure, close to real engineering data. 
 A team with the drive of a startup and the expertise of an established technology site. 
 Excellent professional development opportunities within the Airbus group.

items.jobDescription:
**Willkommen am Fraunhofer-Institut für Integrierte Schaltungen IIS** 
Als größtes Institut der Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft forschen wir seit mehr als 30 Jahren in vielfältigen Themen rund um Künstliche Intelligenz, Mikroelektronik, Sensorik und Datenerfassung sowie Signalverarbeitung und -übertragung. Talente aus unterschiedlichen Ingenieur- und Naturwissenschaften finden bei uns zahlreiche Forschungsfelder unter einem Dach. Einige Aushängeschilder, die unsere Innovationskraft widerspiegeln: Neuromorphes Computing, 5G/6G-Mobilfunktechnologien, Generative KI in der Sprach- und Signalverarbeitung sowie Röntgenbildgebung in der Elektromobilität. Und wir machen noch so viel mehr! 
**Welche zukunftsfähigen Lösungen finden Sie mit uns?** 
 **Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung** 
Die Abteilung **»Audio«** entwickelt innovative Audiocodecs für die Übertragung von Audiosignalen. Unsere Lösungen sind für diverse Signale wie z.B. Sprache und Musik bis hin zu immersivem 3D-Audio über einen breiten Bereich von Bitraten geeignet und werden bereits von großen Anbietern im Streaming- und Broadcastbereich erfolgreich eingesetzt. 
* **Entwicklung und Wartung von Audiocodecsoftware:** Sie sind verantwortlich für die Pflege, Weiterentwicklung und Neuentwicklung von Audiocodecsoftware (insbesondere des xHE-AAC und MPEG-H Encoders sowie dazugehörige Production- und Metadatentools) in C/C++ für Windows, Linux und macOS unter Verwendung von Git, SVN und CMake.
* **Implementierung und Wartung von Softwaretests:** Sie implementieren und pflegen Softwaretests unter Verwendung von Jenkins, Ctest, GoogleTest, Robot Framework und Gitlab CI.
* **Wissenschaftliche Hörtests:** Sie beteiligen sich an wissenschaftlichen Hörtests und führen diese durch, um die Audioqualität aus der Perspektive der Hörer zu bewerten.
 **Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein** 
* Sie haben ein** erfolgreich abgeschlossenes** , wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium in Informatik, Informationstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Naturwissenschaft oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss.
* Sie besitzen **gute Programmierfähigkeiten** , idealerweise in C/C++ und besitzen Expertise in digitaler Signalverarbeitung.
* Sie bringen idealerweise Wissen in den Themen Psychoakustik, Audiocodierung und Audiosignalverarbeitung mit.
* Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche **Kommunikationsfähigkeiten ** in Englisch.
 **Was wir für Sie bereithalten** 
* **Spannende Tätigkeit** : attraktives Arbeitsumfeld bei einem Weltmarktführer in einer hochinnovativen Schlüsselbranche
* **Praxisbezogene Projekte bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden Gestaltungsfreiraum** : Sie motivieren dazu, Innovationen aktiv voranzutreiben und eigene Ideen einzubringen.
* **Engagierte Teams fördern Kreativität und Eigenverantwortung** : Hier haben Sie die Freiheit, Ihre Ideen zu entwickeln und aktiv mitzugestalten.
* **Persönlicher Kontakt ist uns wichtig** : Durch strukturiertes Onboarding erweitern Sie Ihr Netzwerk und kommen gut an unserem Institut an.
* **Ihre Bedürfnisse nehmen wir ernst** : Die bestmögliche Vereinbarkeit Ihres Berufs- und Privatlebens unterstützen wir durch zeitliche Flexibilität und hybrides Arbeiten.
* **Wir schaffen Raum für Begegnung** : Sportliche Angebote vor Ort und remote, Events sowie Gemeinschaftsräume bringen unsere Mitarbeitenden zusammen.
* **Unsere Mitarbeitenden genießen unsere wertschätzende Kultur** : Wir sind offen, hilfsbereit und pflegen einen vertrauensvollen Umgang miteinander.
* **Top Ausstattung am Arbeitsplatz** : Mit unseren State-of-the-Art Technologien entwickeln wir Lösungen für Herausforderungen der Gegenwart und Zukunft.
* **Ihre Ziele und Interessen liegen uns am Herzen** : Wir unterstützen Sie regelmäßig durch fachliche und persönliche Seminare, Coachings sowie Sprachkurse.
Fraunhofer ist nicht nur die größte Organisation für anwendungsorientierte Forschung in Europa – wir gelten auch als Top Arbeitgeber!
Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.
Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt **39** Stunden. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf **zwei Jahre ** befristet. Die Stelle kann auch in Teilzeit besetzt werden, jedoch möglichst vollzeitnah. Eine Verlängerung ist möglich. Anstellung, Vergütung und Sozialleistungen basieren auf dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD). Zusätzlich kann Fraunhofer leistungs- und erfolgsabhängige variable Vergütungsbestandteile gewähren.
 **Über Fraunhofer** 
Die **Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft** ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 75 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 32 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.
Fraunhofer ist nicht nur die größte Organisation für anwendungsorientierte Forschung in Europa – wir gelten auch als Top Arbeitgeber!
Mit Ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.
 **Bereit für Veränderung?** 
**Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt online mit Ihren aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse). Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!** 
Sie haben Fragen zum Bewerbungsablauf? Unsere Recruiterinnen Svenja Hofmann und Claudia Kestler-Böhm sind für Sie da:recruiting@iis.fraunhofer.de

# Electrical Systems Engineer (m/w/d)

Mit branchenübergreifendem Know-how und einem ganzheitlichen System- und Produktverständnis schaffen wir technologische Lösungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Wir beschäftigen uns mit den Trendthemen Digitalisierung, E-Mobilität und Autonome Systeme hauptsächlich für die Branchen Automotive, Luftfahrt, Defence und Maschinenbau und ermöglichen hier konsequent die Entstehung passgenauer Lösungen. Daran arbeiten wir jeden Tag – mit rund 12.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an über 50 Standorten weltweit.

- Entwicklung und Koordination der elektrischen Integration verschiedener Systeme in Fluggastsitzen unter Einhaltung der Vorschriften

- Verwalten und Reduktion von Varianten der Elektrikinstallation
### **Was Sie mitbringen:**
- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Fachrichtung Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Hohe technische Affinität und Begeisterung für Premiumprodukte
- Idealerweise mehrjährige Berufserfahrung
- Kenntnisse in Elektrikintegration in Catia V5
- Kenntnisse in modularer Konstruktionsmethodik
- Kenntnisse von luftfahrtspezifischen Anforderungen an Elektrikintegration
- Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Wir machen aus Sensorik Zukunft.
Elektroniker (m/w/d) - Fertigung optischer Messtechnik in Langebrück
Vollzeit (40 Stunden/Woche) | Keine Schichtarbeit, Keine Wochenendarbeit | Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag | Arbeit im Sauberraum | Filigrane Arbeit
Als Entwickler und Hersteller von optischer Messtechnik schlägt unser Herz für Technologie und Innovation. Präzision mit Licht ist unser Motto. Mehr Präzision unser Antrieb. Dieses Ziel verfolgen unsere ambitionierten und verantwortungsbewussten Kolleginnen und Kollegen Tag für Tag. Als Elektroniker (m/w/d) verstärken Sie unsere Fertigung unter Sauberraumbedingungen. Mit Ihrer Arbeit leisten Sie einen wesentlichen Beitrag für neue Technologien, Ihr zukünftiges Team und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. Gemeinsam machen wir aus Sensorik Zukunft.
Sie sind kein Elektroniker (m/w/d), haben aber ein Händchen für Technik und ein Auge fürs Detail? Dann passen Sie zu uns!
Für die Fertigung unserer hochpräzisen optischen Messsysteme suchen wir Menschen, die gerne mit den Händen arbeiten, technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und auch bei kleinsten Komponenten höchste Präzision an den Tag legen.
Ihr zukünftiges Aufgabengebiet
 Sie verstärken eines unserer Fertigungsteams und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag für die Herstellung unserer hochpräzisen optischen Messsysteme. 
 Mit Fingerspitzengefühl montieren und justieren Sie elektronische, mechanische und optische Baugruppen. 
 Sie prüfen, reinigen und bearbeiten optische Komponenten mit höchster Sorgfalt, um die Qualität und Leistungsfähigkeit unserer Sensorsysteme sicherzustellen. 
 Sie gleichen Leiterplatten und elektronische Baugruppen ab und nehmen diese fachgerecht in Betrieb. 
 Das Durchführen von Klebearbeiten an mechanischen und optischen Bauteilen zählt ebenfalls zu Ihren Aufgaben. 
 Sie kalibrieren unsere Sensoren und schaffen damit die Grundlage für zuverlässige und präzise Messergebnisse. 
 Ihr Profil
 Sie verfügen idealerweise über eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, z. B. als Elektroniker für Geräte und Systeme (m/w/d) oder einen vergleichbaren elektrotechnischen bzw. mechatronischen Beruf. 
 Sie arbeiten gerne präzise und konzentriert und haben Freude an filigranen Montage- und Justagearbeiten. 
 Der sorgfältige Umgang mit empfindlichen elektronischen und optischen Komponenten ist für Sie selbstverständlich. 
 Idealerweise haben Sie bereits Erfahrung im Löten, Montieren, Justieren, Prüfen oder Kalibrieren technischer Baugruppen. 
 Ihr Arbeitsstil ist durch Teamfähigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und Gewissenhaftigkeit geprägt. 
 Kommunikation ist bei uns ein wichtiger Teil unseres Erfolgs. Als Hersteller optischer Messtechnik entwickeln und fertigen wir unsere Produkte selbst. Dadurch arbeiten all unsere Fachbereiche eng zusammen. Deutsch ist unsere Unternehmenssprache. Für die Abstimmung technischer Sachverhalte, den Austausch von Fachwissen und die sichere Verwendung unserer fachspezifischen Begriffe setzen wir daher Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau nach GER voraus.

 Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld 
 Betriebliche Altersvorsorge 
 Steuerfreie Gutscheinkarte, 50 € /Monat

 Langfristige berufliche Perspektive in einem stetig wachsenden Unternehmen 
 Strukturierte Einarbeitungsprozesse 
 Familienfreundlichkeit und Flexibilität durch Arbeiten in Gleitzeit und verschiedene Arbeitszeitmodelle

items.jobDescription:
Test Cell Engineer (Engineer I), Johnson Matthey, Inc., Taylor, MI:
 Perform analytical review of standardized test cycles and aging protocols for diesel and gasoline platforms. Conduct software test cycle programming using test cell automation and control systems. Perform modern gasoline engine diagnostic and modern diesel engine diagnostics. Execute full emissions and aftertreatment system evaluations. Test and analyze aftertreatment components including DOC, SCR, DPF, CSF, DEC, ASC, GPF, TWC, and related systems. Perform testing and data integrity analysis. Conduct analytical review of multiple standardized test cycles and aging protocols for diesel and gasoline platforms. Program and validate software test cycle programming. Design and implement test cell automation. Create and implement test plans. Provide project management support, including implementing process improvements, calibrations, maintenance and program deliverables. Generate data reporting and summary presentations for customers and training technicians.
Full time employment, Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week.
 MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering or a related field and 5 years of progressive post-baccalaureate related work experience.
Of the required experience, must have 5 years of experience in all of the following:
 Performing automotive and engine testing using Data Acquisition Systems (A&D); and
 Performing data acquisition and analysis of Engine aftertreatment system test data. 
 Of the required experience, must have 2 years of experience in all of the following:
 Software programming; 
 Utilizing software for test and measurement data management, exploration, analysis, and automation; 
 Applying knowledge of aftertreatment fundamentals for test design, data analysis, diagnostics and trouble shooting; 
 Executing automotive calibrations; 
 Conducting aftertreatment testing; 
 Measuring and analyzing emissions; and 
 Applying knowledge of engine fundamentals (both gasoline and diesel) for test design, data analysis, diagnostics and trouble shooting. 
 Must have 1 year of experience applying aftertreatment chemistry principles for test design, data analysis, diagnostics and trouble shooting.

 Du konzipierst, bereitest und steuerst Tests der elektronischen Abrechnungsverfahren

 Die fachliche Steuerung externer Dienstleister sowie die Bearbeitung von Anfragen unterstützt du

 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum / zur Bilanzbuchhalter:in, Fachinformatiker:in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

 Unser Anspruch ist es, allen Kandidat:innen bei gleicher Eignung die gleichen Chancen für den Einstieg bei uns zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv die Vielfalt und das Miteinander in unseren Teams. Wir schätzen jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.
 Benefits:
 Bei uns können alle DB Mitarbeitenden günstig shoppen. Jeden Monat findest du auf dem DB Reisemarkt neue Angebote, wie z.B. Mobilfunkverträge, Versicherungen, Vergünstigungen bei Hotelketten, Mode und Lifestyle.

items.jobDescription:
Das Institut für Satellitengeodäsie und Inertialsensorik des Deutschen Zentrums für Luft- und Raumfahrt e.V. (DLR) in Hannover, Niedersachsen, widmet sich primär Forschungsfragen im Kontext der Nutzung von Quantentechnologien und Quantensensoren und entwickelt Quantenmesstechniken für innovative Anwendungen, bis hin zur Realisierung von Prototypenlösungen.
 Das erwartet dich 
 Am Institut für Satellitengeodäsie und Inertialsensorik beschäftigt sich die Abteilung Quantensensorik mit der Entwicklung von Quantensensoren für die Inertialsensorik, z. B. Anwendungen in der Erdbeobachtung. Dafür werden die zugrundeliegenden Konzepte in der Atomoptik und Atominterferometrie weiterentwickelt und in Prototypen im Labor sowie in relevanten Umgebungen getestet. In diesem Rahmen hat das Kooperationsprojekt BECCAL das Ziel, eine Nutzlast für atomoptische und atominterferometrische Experimente in der Mikrogravitationsumgebung der Internationalen Weltraumstation zu realisieren.
 Es erwartet dich ein dynamisches Forschungsumfeld, das sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt. Darüber hinaus triffst du auf ein kollegiales Team, das den Wissenstransfer voranbringt und gemeinsam mit dir lernen möchte.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Entwicklung und Test von Elektronik und anderen Komponenten sowie Konstruktion von Bauteilen für Quantensensoren
 Integration von Elektronik und anderen Komponenten in einen Quantensensoraufbau sowie Test und Charakterisierung im Labor
 Durchführung von Experimenten sowie Auswertung, Modellierung und Koordination von Entwicklungstätigkeiten
 Das bringst du mit 
 abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master/Diplom) der Ingenieurswissenschaften (z. B. aus der Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik) oder der Naturwissenschaften (z. B. Fachrichtung Physik) oder anderer für die Tätigkeit relevanter Studiengänge 
 Erfahrung in den Bereichen Elektronikentwicklung bzw. der Auslegung von Schaltungen (z. B. mit EAGLE oder SPICE), Erstellung von Schaltplänen und Komponentenauswahl, Konstruktion, Durchführung von Tests
 praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Elektronik sowie Löterfahrung und Arbeiten im Labor
 gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 
 Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Notre sens :  "Bring people together through sport to make wellbeing accessible for all." 
Chez Decathlon, notre ambition est claire : rassembler autour du sport et rendre le bien-être accessible au plus grand nombre.
Pour donner vie à cet objectif, nous nous appuyons sur deux forces majeures :
 Nos coéquipiers, qui sont le cœur battant de notre écosystème.
 Notre ancrage local, qui nous lie à chaque communauté sportive pour offrir des solutions uniques (produits, services et expériences).

 iOS et Android

 Tu as une expérience solide et confirmée en test d'applications et tests de firmware.

 Tu es reconnu·e pour ton esprit de synthèse, ta rigueur et ta capacité à évangéliser les bonnes pratiques de qualité.
 Tu sais t'intégrer et collaborer efficacement dans un environnement agile.
 Tu es basé·e à  Lille , prêt·e à tester sur les machines de sport à 50m de ton bureau.
 POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

 Weiterbildung als Elektroprojektleiter Installation und Sicherheit mit eidg. Fachausweis oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im elektrotechnischen Umfeld
 Erfahrung in der Abwicklung von Projekten, idealerweise im Umfeld Elektroinstallation, Industrie, Gebäudetechnik oder technischer Infrastruktur
 Proaktive, zuverlässige und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit Freude daran, für Kunden die Extrameile zu gehen
 Kommunikationsstärke, Verhandlungsgeschick und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen sauber zusammenzuführen

 Attraktives Salär, überdurchschnittliche Pensionskasse, weitere sehr gute Versicherungslösungen und attraktive Zusatzleistungen

Build Europe's semiconductor future with us! Join us to build up one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites in Dresden. 
As a  Quality Control Technician you serve as the final quality gate before our products reach global customers.  
In this role, you combine automated optical inspection (AVI), systematic defect review, and final documentation checks in a cutting-edge cleanroom facility. During your onboarding starting in February 2027, you will complete a 6-month training program in Taiwan to gain hands-on fab experience, master core inspection procedures, and build a strong international network.
 Job Responsibilities Operate optical inspection tools and manage Automated Visual Inspection recipes.
 Perform detailed defect reviews, verify hold lots, and generate structured defect reports for engineering evaluation.
 Validate outgoing wafer documentation and ensure strict compliance with quality, handling, and shipping standards.
 Execute cleanroom environmental monitoring and support routine tool calibration and 6S audit processes.
 Conduct initial troubleshooting on inspection equipment and execute lot disposition according to standard procedures.
 Manage operational inventory of cleanroom parts, consumables, and Front Opening Shipping Boxes.
 Handle manual packing and safe dispatch preparation of finished goods for warehouse transfer.
 Work in rotating shift schedules (initially a 2-shift model, transitioning to a continuous 5-crew 3-shift roster).
 Your profile Must Have:   Completed technical vocational training (Berufsausbildung) or equivalent with technical background/aptitude.
 Hands-on experience in manufacturing, production, or quality inspection environments. Semiconductor experience is a plus, but motivated entry-level candidates and cross-industry applicants are welcome).
 Willingness to work in a cleanroom environment (90%), covering physical material handling as well as stationary desk-based analysis.
 Readiness to work rotating shifts.
 Solid PC literacy (MS Office, especially Excel).
 Professional English proficiency (min. B2) and at least basic German language skills.
 Availability for onboarding in February 2027, including the 6-month training in Tainan, Taiwan.
 Nice to Have:   Prior experience in cleanroom environments, semiconductor manufacturing, or precision industries (e.g., optics, electronics, medical technology).
 Basic understanding of defect inspection systems, statistical process control, or 6S principles.
 Mandarin language skills (beneficial for cross-site collaboration).
 Reasons to join ESMC Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.
 Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
 Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden.
 Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you continuously expand your knowledge.
 Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit.
 Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket).
 Application documents Please apply with your English CV.

Notre mission ⚖️ 
 Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.
 Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.
 Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.
 Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.
 Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.
 Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.
 Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.
 Sujet de stage
 Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Dans ce contexte, l’application permet aux utilisateurs d’uploader de nombreux types de fichiers (PDF, Word, images, etc) à partir de nombreuses sources.
 L’objectif du stage est d’améliorer les outils présents dans l’application pour visualiser et manipuler ces documents. Ceci peut inclure :
 Visualiser les PDF mais également d’autres types de documents (Word, images, etc) directement dans le navigateur, d’une manière scalable et sécurisée,
 Ajouter plus d’options pour configurer la visualisation (zoom, recherche, orientation, etc),
 Superposer le texte issu de l’OCR au document original afin de permettre à l’utilisateur de sélectionner et copier le texte,
 Ajouter des fonctionnalités de découpage, fusion, et de changement d’ordre des pages,
 Et d’autres fonctionnalités !
 Ces fonctionnalités sont disponibles à travers toute l’expérience de Doctrine autour des documents privés, y compris dans l’Assistant, les dossiers collaboratifs, et les outils spécialisés tels Flow Litigate et Flow Counsel.
 Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Productivity, et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).
 Les à-côtés du poste 👁️ 
 Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
 Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
 Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
 Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins
 Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 
 Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
 Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
 Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
 Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.
 Nos valeurs 🤝 
 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.
 Challenge the status quo : n ous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
 Liberty and responsibility : n ous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
 Knowledge is power : l 'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
 Release early, release often and listen to your customers : n ous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
 Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️ 
 🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.
 🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles
 🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne
 🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers
 📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise
 🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être
 🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale  Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an
 👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan
 🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)
 💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal
 🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple
 Notre processus de recrutement 🚀 
 Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
 Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager , pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
 Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
 Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
 (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)

 Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins. 
 Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !

 Contexte du stage
Depuis des années, Doctrine propose une fonctionnalité d’envoi de décision de justice en France à ses clients. Cela est une source précieuse de décisions de justice qui permet à Doctrine d’enrichir sa base de données (c'est-à-dire son legal graph) avec des décisions qui n’ont pas pu être ajoutées par nos processus habituels.
Le but de ce stage est l’internationalisation de cette fonctionnalité de manière à ce qu’elle soit utilisable dans tous les autres pays où Doctrine est actif (Italie, Allemagne).
Les tâches principales seront : 
 Le développement d’une application minimale pour la revue et validation des décisions de justice mises en ligne par nos utilisateurs pour nos juristes avant leur publication.
 La migration du processus legacy d’upload français actuel pour se conformer au processus commun (internationalisé).
 Une fois que le processus de mise en ligne de décisions par nos utilisateurs sera internationalisé, le ou la stagiaire pourra travailler sur des tâches d’amélioration de l’application de revue de décisions dans le but d’aider notre équipe de juristes à mieux traiter le volume de décisions mises en ligne.
Exemples de pistes d’amélioration (non exhaustif) 
 Application de techniques d’OCR sur les documents pour faciliter leur validation.
 Détection via LLM d’attributs des décisions (niveau de confidentialité, juridiction, domaine du droit, cour, …) pour faciliter leur validation.
 Aide au retrait de contenu qui n’est pas le texte de la décision (pages blanches, notification à l’avocat, …).
Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la définition de la solution et sa réalisation. Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Italie et sera amené·e à travailler avec les équipes des autres pays (principalement l’équipe France) et l’équipe légale. Il ou elle participera aussi au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs full stack de l’entreprise).
 Les à-côtés du poste 👁️

 Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

 Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
 Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
 Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.
 Nos valeurs 🤝

 Challenge the status quo : n ous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
 Liberty and responsibility : n ous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.

items.jobTitle: Staff Windows Low Level C++ Engineer - Endpoint security
items.jobDescription:
Our Purpose 
 At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
 About Us 
 SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
 Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
 What Are We Looking For? 
 We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
 As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide. 
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our Endpoint Protection product , the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. ( We're currently growing multiple teams and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).
 The Platform group teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:
 Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,
 usermode security & agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.
 By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more. 
 What will you do? 
 As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode & kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.
 You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system.
 Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).
 Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).
 You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.
 Working setup: Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.
 What skills & knowledge should you bring? 
 Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)
 Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools
 Previous experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deployment
 Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
 Attention to detail and high coding standards
 An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis
 Why SentinelOne? 
 AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
 We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:
 Equity & Rewards 
 Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
 Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
 Time Off & Wellbeing 
 Competitive leave benefits
 Gender-neutral parental leave
 Insurance & Financial Security 
 Medical and insurance benefits
 Disability insurance
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
 Work Perks & Flexibility 
 Global home office allowance
 Mobile phone reimbursement
 Work-from-home allowance
 SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 
 SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.  
 To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our  AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure .

Are you ready to unleash your entrepreneurial spirit and be a part of an exciting start-up revolution as the main driver for its growth and success? 
 About us 
 SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.
 SetSales is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.
 The Opportunity. 
 As a MBA Graduate, you will run, grow and manage all aspects of SetSales. You will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team, ensuring the successful execution of the conference and strategy of the brand. 
 You’ll want this job if you possess strong leadership skills, excellent communication abilities, highly ambitious, forward-thinking and driven to inspire and lead a team. You are someone who is thrilled to work in a fast-paced environment and wants to scale the company rapidly.
 Responsibilities :
 Recruit, build and develop a high-performing team. 
 Build an ecosystem and deliver outstanding products.
 Set clear expectations, establish goals, and provide ongoing detailed feedback and performance evaluations.
 Execute the strategy at a rapid pace.
 Develop the company’s brand as the go-to place for inspiration, knowledge and networking. 
 Oversee planning, execution, and completion of conferences within the designated timelines and budget constraints.
 Assign tasks to team members in each department, monitor progress, and ensure project objectives are achieved.
 Identify opportunities to expand business with existing clients and collaborate with business development teams for new client acquisition.
 What we offer you 
 You’ll be working in person at our HQ in London (next to Sloane Square), constantly pushing you out of your comfort zone to ensure a never-ending growth curve for you and the business. We provide you with the following:
 The opportunity to lead, run and develop a fast-growing business, where your work and the results are highly tangible and make all the difference. 
 Work with an incredible team with a track record of developing and growing businesses. 
 Travel opportunity: You will be joining our conferences overseas. 
 Competitive salary
 Requirement 
 +4 years’ experience from an institution with high speed and work ethic e.g. management consulting, investment banking, top-tier corporate or start-up. 
 Bachelor’s degree with outstanding results, maybe followed by an MBA
 Strong commercial awareness and a passion for business. 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 Proven track record delivering results.
 UK, EU or US work permit

Are you looking for challenges within an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? If so, now is the time to apply for our 4 months paid Internship Program in London.
 About us 
 SetSales is part of United Media ( https://www.united-media.com/ ) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.
 What we offer you 
 As part of our Internship Program in London, you will rocket launch your career in a high-paced environment with a continuously steep learning curve. In short, we offer the brightest talents:
 An opportunity to fast-track your career through responsibility for high-impact projects that constantly push you out of your comfort zone
 Hands-on experience building and scaling ventures together with the sharpest minds
 An amazing network and the possibility of reporting directly to C-level staff and Managing Directors
 Given the opportunity to collaborate on projects with industry leaders 
 Mentorship and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the founder of our company, Mads Faurholt
 Potential for permanent employment after the internship
 Your responsibilities 
 You’ll be part of building and scaling companies, which, depending on the role you’ll take, could entail responsibilities such as:
 Supporting our recruitment function covering everything from candidate sourcing to speaking with potential candidates
 Being part of creating connections with key players from the industry, like CEOs, entrepreneurs, for example, co-founders of Airbnb, Starbucks etc. building and maintaining valuable relationships with them.
 Working on marketing and SoMe content creation by developing, implementing and managing social media and marketing strategy
 Data analysis; extracting the correct data for analysis, and ability to interpret and relay the data.
 What we expect from you 
 You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:
 Have or are in the process of finishing your bachelor's with outstanding results
 Have experience from part-time work and/or from extracurricular activities
 Are fluent in English, written and spoken.
 Have exceptional attention to detail
 Possess exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills
 Starting day 
 January 2024. Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria station) and do not offer remote work.

Are you ready to unleash your entrepreneurial spirit and be a part of an exciting start-up revolution as the main driver for its growth and success? 
 About us 
 SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.
 SetSales is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.
 The Opportunity. 
 On the Leadership Program, you will run, grow and manage all aspects of SetSales. You will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team, ensuring the successful execution of the conference and strategy of the brand. 
 You’ll want this job if you possess strong leadership skills, excellent communication abilities, highly ambitious, forward-thinking and driven to inspire and lead a team. You are someone who is thrilled to work in a fast-paced environment and wants to scale the company rapidly.
 Responsibilities :
 Recruit, build and develop a high-performing team. 
 Build an ecosystem and deliver outstanding products.
 Set clear expectations, establish goals, and provide ongoing detailed feedback and performance evaluations.
 Execute the strategy at a rapid pace.
 Develop the company’s brand as the go-to place for inspiration, knowledge and networking. 
 Oversee planning, execution, and completion of conferences within the designated timelines and budget constraints.
 Assign tasks to team members in each department, monitor progress, and ensure project objectives are achieved.
 Identify opportunities to expand business with existing clients and collaborate with business development teams for new client acquisition.
 What we offer you 
 You’ll be working in person at our HQ in London (next to Sloane Square), constantly pushing you out of your comfort zone to ensure a never-ending growth curve for you and the business. We provide you with the following:
 The opportunity to lead, run and develop a fast-growing business, where your work and the results are highly tangible and make all the difference. 
 Work with an incredible team with a track record of developing and growing businesses. 
 Travel opportunity: You will be joining our conferences overseas. 
 Competitive salary
 Requirement 
 +4 years’ experience from an institution with high speed and work ethic e.g. management consulting, investment banking, top-tier corporate or start-up. 
 Bachelor’s degree with outstanding results, maybe followed by an MBA
 Strong commercial awareness and a passion for business. 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 Proven track record delivering results.
 UK, EU or US work permit
